pli-tv-kd1:0.1: vinayapiṭake paṭhamo bhāgo namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
pli-tv-kd1:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā uruvelāyaṃ viharati najjā nerañjarāya tīre bodhirukkhamūle paṭhamābhisambuddho.
pli-tv-kd1:1.1.2: atha kho bhagavā bodhirukkhamūle sattāhaṃ ekapallaṅkena nisīdi vimuttisukhapaṭisaṃvedī.
pli-tv-kd1:1.2.1: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ paṭiccasamuppādaṃ anulomapaṭilomaṃ manasākāsi:
pli-tv-kd1:1.2.2: avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā; saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ; viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ; nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ; saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso; phassapaccayā vedanā; vedanāpaccayā taṇhā; taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ; upādānapaccayā bhavo; bhavapaccayā jāti; jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti.
pli-tv-kd1:1.2.4: avijjāyatveva asesavirāganirodhā saṅkhāranirodho; saṅkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho; viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodho; nāmarūpanirodhā saḷāyatananirodho; saḷāyatananirodhā phassanirodho; phassanirodhā vedanānirodho; vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho; taṇhānirodhā upādānanirodho; upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho; bhavanirodhā jātinirodho; jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti.
pli-tv-kd1:1.3.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:-
pli-tv-kd1:1.4.1: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ paṭiccasamuppādaṃ anulomapaṭilomaṃ manasākāsi:
pli-tv-kd1:1.4.2: avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā; saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ; viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ; nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ …pe…
pli-tv-kd1:1.5.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:-
pli-tv-kd1:1.6.1: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paṭiccasamuppādaṃ anulomapaṭilomaṃ manasākāsi:
pli-tv-kd1:1.6.2: avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā; saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ; viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ; nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ …pe…
pli-tv-kd1:1.7.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:-
pli-tv-kd1:2.1.1: atha kho bhagavā sattāhassa accayena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhahitvā bodhirukkhamūlā yena ajapālanigrodho, tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā ajapālanigrodhamūle sattāhaṃ ekapallaṅkena nisīdi vimuttisukhapaṭisaṃvedī.
pli-tv-kd1:2.2.1: atha kho aññataro huhuṅkajātiko brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-kd1:2.2.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāranīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:2.2.4: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:2.2.5: “kittāvatā nu kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇo hoti? katame ca pana brāhmaṇakaraṇā dhammā?”ti
pli-tv-kd1:2.3.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:-
pli-tv-kd1:3.1.1: atha kho bhagavā sattāhassa accayena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhahitvā ajapālanigrodhamūlā yena mucalindo tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā mucalindamūle sattāhaṃ ekapallaṅkena nisīdi vimuttisukhapaṭisaṃvedī.
pli-tv-kd1:3.2.1: tena kho pana samayena mahā akālamegho udapādi; sattāhavaddalikā sītavātaduddinī.
pli-tv-kd1:3.2.2: atha kho mucalindo nāgarājā sakabhavanā nikkhamitvā bhagavato kāyaṃ sattakkhattuṃ bhogehi parikkhipitvā upari muddhani mahantaṃ phaṇaṃ karitvā aṭṭhāsi:
pli-tv-kd1:3.2.3: “mā bhagavantaṃ sītaṃ. mā bhagavantaṃ uṇhaṃ, mā bhagavantaṃ ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphasso”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:3.3.1: atha kho mucalindo nāgarājā sattāhassa accayena viddhaṃ vigatavalāhakaṃ devaṃ viditvā bhagavato kāyā bhoge viniveṭhetvā sakavaṇṇaṃ paṭisaṃharitvā māṇavakavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā bhagavato purato aṭṭhāsi pañjaliko bhagavantaṃ namassamāno.
pli-tv-kd1:3.3.2: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:-
pli-tv-kd1:4.1.1: atha kho bhagavā sattāhassa accayena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhahitvā mucalindamūlā yena rājāyatanaṃ, tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā rājāyatanamūle sattāhaṃ ekapallaṅkena nisīdi vimuttisukhapaṭisaṃvedī.
pli-tv-kd1:4.2.1: tena kho pana samayena tapussubhallikā vāṇijā ukkalā taṃ desaṃ addhānamaggappaṭipannā honti.
pli-tv-kd1:4.2.2: atha kho tapussabhallikānaṃ vāṇijānaṃ ñātisālohitā devatā tapussabhallike vāṇije etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:4.2.4: gacchatha taṃ bhagavantaṃ manthena ca madhupiṇḍikāya ca patimānetha.
pli-tv-kd1:4.2.5: taṃ vo bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:4.3.1: atha kho tapussabhallikā vāṇijā manthañca madhupiṇḍikañca ādāya yena bhagavā, tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:4.3.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho tapussabhallikā vāṇijā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:4.3.3: “patigaṇhātu no bhante, bhagavā manthañca madhupiṇḍikañca yaṃ amhākaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:4.4.3: kimhi nu kho ahaṃ patigaṇheyyaṃ manthañca madhupiṇḍikañcāti.
pli-tv-kd1:4.4.4: atha kho cattāro mahārājā bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya catuddisā cattāro selamaye patte bhagavato upanāmesuṃ-
pli-tv-kd1:4.4.6: paṭiggahesi bhagavā paccagghe selamaye patte manthañca madhupiṇḍikañca. paṭiggahetvā ca paribhuñji.
pli-tv-kd1:4.5.1: atha kho tapussabhallikā vāṇijā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:4.5.2: “ete mayaṃ bhante, bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañca. upāsake no bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupete saraṇaṃ gate”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:4.5.3: te ca loke paṭhamaṃ upāsakā ahesuṃ dvevācikā.
pli-tv-kd1:5.1.1: atha kho bhagavā sattāhassa accayena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhahitvā rājāyatanamūlā yena ajapālanigrodho, tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-kd1:5.2.1: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd1:5.2.2: “adhigato kho myāyaṃ dhammo gambhīro duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo.
pli-tv-kd1:5.2.4: ālayarāmāya kho pana pajāya ālayaratāya ālayasammuditāya duddasaṃ idaṃ ṭhānaṃ - yadidaṃ idappaccayatāpaaccasamuppādo.
pli-tv-kd1:5.2.5: idampi kho ṭhānaṃ sududdasaṃ - yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:5.2.6: ahañceva kho pana dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, pare ca me na ājāneyyuṃ, so mama’ssa kilamatho sā mama’ssa vihesā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:5.3.1: apissu bhagavantaṃ imā anacchariyā gāthāyo paṭibhaṃsu pubbe assutapubbā:
pli-tv-kd1:5.4.1: itiha bhagavato paṭisañcikkhato appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati, no dhammadesanāya.
pli-tv-kd1:5.4.2: atha kho brahmuno sahampatissa bhagavato cetasā ceto parivitakkamaññāya etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:5.4.3: “nassati vata bho, loko; vinassati vata bho, loko; yatra hi nāma tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati, no dhammadesanāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:5.5.1: atha kho brahmā sahampati seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evameva brahmaloke antarahito bhagavato purato pāturahosi.
pli-tv-kd1:5.6.1: atha kho brahmā sahampati ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dakkhiṇaṃ jāṇumaṇḍalaṃ puthuviyaṃ nihantvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:5.6.2: “desetu bhante, bhagavā dhammaṃ. desetu sugato dhammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:5.6.3: santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā. assavaṇatā dhammassa parihāyanti. bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:5.7.1: idamavoca brahmā sahampati, idaṃ vatvāna athāparaṃ etadavoca:-
pli-tv-kd1:5.10.1: atha kho bhagavā brahmuno ca ajjhesanaṃ viditvā sattesu ca kāruññataṃ paṭicca buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ olokesi.
pli-tv-kd1:5.11.1: addasā kho bhagavā buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ olokento satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante.
pli-tv-kd1:5.11.2: seyyathāpi nāma uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakānuggatāni anto nimuggaposīni, appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni samodakaṃ ṭhitāni, appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakaṃ accuggamma ṭhittanti anupalittāni udakena;
pli-tv-kd1:5.11.3: evameva bhagavā buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ olokento addasa satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino5 viharante.
pli-tv-kd1:5.13.2: ‘katāvakāso kho’mhi bhagavatā dhammadesanāyā’ti bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.1.2: “kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ?
pli-tv-kd1:6.1.5: “ayaṃ kho āḷāro kālāmo paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī dīgharattaṃ apparajakkhajātiko.
pli-tv-kd1:6.1.6: yannūnāhaṃ āḷārassa kālāmassa paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ; so imaṃ dhammaṃ khippameva ājānissatī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.2.1: atha kho antarahitā devatā bhagavato ārocesi: “sattāhakālakato bhante, āḷāro kālāmo”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.2.2: bhagavato’pi kho ñāṇaṃ udapādi: “sattāhakālakato āḷāro kālāmo”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.2.5: sace hi so imaṃ dhammaṃ suṇeyya, khippameva ājāneyyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.3.2: “kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ?
pli-tv-kd1:6.3.5: “ayaṃ kho uddako rāmaputto paṇḍito byatto medhāvī dīgharattaṃ apparajakkhajātiko.
pli-tv-kd1:6.3.6: yannūnāhaṃ udakassa rāmaputtassa paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ; so imaṃ dhammaṃ khippameva ājānissatī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.4.1: atha kho antarahitā devatā bhagavato ārocesi: “abhidosakālakato bhante, uddako rāmaputto”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.4.2: bhagavato’pi kho ñāṇaṃ udapādi: “abhidosakālakato uddako rāmaputto”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.4.5: sace hi so imaṃ dhammaṃ suṇeyya, khippameva ājāneyyā”ti
pli-tv-kd1:6.5.2: “kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ?
pli-tv-kd1:6.5.5: bahukārā kho me pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū, ye maṃ padhānapahitattaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:6.6.1: yannūnāhaṃ pañcavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyanti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.6.4: addasā kho bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena pañcavaggiye bhikkhū bārāṇasiyaṃ viharante isipatane migadāye.
pli-tv-kd1:6.6.5: atha kho bhagavā uruvelāyaṃ yathābhirattaṃ viharitvā yena bārāṇasī, tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.7.1: addasā kho upako ājīvako bhagavantaṃ antarā ca gayaṃ antarā ca bodhiṃ addhānamaggappaṭipannaṃ. disvāna bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:6.7.2: “vippasannāni kho te āvuso indriyāni. parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto.
pli-tv-kd1:6.7.3: kaṃ si tvaṃ āvuso uddissa pabbajito?
pli-tv-kd1:6.8.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā upakaṃ ājīvakaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:-
pli-tv-kd1:6.9.1: yathā kho tvaṃ āvuso paṭijānāsi, arahasi anantajinoti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.9.6: evaṃ vutte upako ājīvako “hupeyyapāvuso”ti vatvā sīsaṃ okampetvā ummaggaṃ gahetvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.10.1: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena bārāṇasī isipatanaṃ migadāyo, yena pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū, tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-kd1:6.10.2: addasaṃsu kho pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ dūrato’va āgacchantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:6.10.4: “ayaṃ āvuso samaṇo gotamo āgacchati bāhuliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya.
pli-tv-kd1:6.10.5: so neva abhivādetabbo. na paccuṭṭhātabbo. nāssa pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:6.10.6: api ca kho āsanaṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ, sace ākaṅkhissati, nisīdissatī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.11.1: yathā yathā kho bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū upasaṅkamati, tathā tathā te pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū nāsakkhiṃsu sakāya katikāya saṇṭhātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:6.11.2: asaṇṭhahantā bhagavantaṃ paccuggantvā eko bhagavato pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesi. eko āsanaṃ paññāpesi. eko pādodakaṃ, eko pādapīṭhaṃ eko pādakaṭhalikaṃ upanikkhipi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.11.5: apissu bhagavantaṃ nāmena ca āvusovādena ca samudācaranti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.12.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:6.12.2: “mā bhikkhave tathāgataṃ nāmena ca āvusovādena ca samudācarittha.
pli-tv-kd1:6.12.3: arahaṃ bhikkhave, tathāgato sammāsambuddho. odahatha bhikkhave, sotaṃ. amatamadhigataṃ. ahamanusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.12.5: yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ
pli-tv-kd1:6.12.6: brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.13.1: evaṃ vutte pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:6.13.2: “tāya’pi kho tvaṃ āvuso gotama, iriyāya tāya paṭipadāya tāya dukkarakārikāya nevajjhagā uttari manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ. kimpana tvaṃ etarahi, bāhuliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya adhigamissasi uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesa”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.14.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:6.14.2: “na bhikkhave tathāgato bāhuliko. na padhānavibbhanto. na āvatto bāhullāya.
pli-tv-kd1:6.14.4: odahatha bhikkhave, sotaṃ. amatamadhigataṃ, ahamanusāsāmi. ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.14.6: yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ
pli-tv-kd1:6.14.7: brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.15.1: dutiyampi kho pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ …pe…
pli-tv-kd1:6.15.2: dutiyampi kho bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etadavoca …pe…
pli-tv-kd1:6.15.3: tatiyampi kho pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:6.15.4: “tāya’pi kho tvaṃ āvuso gotama tāya iriyāya tāya paṭipadāya tāya dukkarakārikāya nevajjhagā uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ. kimpana tvaṃ etaragi bāhuliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya, adhigamissasi uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesa”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.16.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:6.16.2: “abhijānātha me no tumhe bhikkhave ito pubbe evarūpaṃ bhāsitameta”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.16.4: arahaṃ bhikkhave tathāgato sammāsambuddho. odahatha bhikkhave, sotaṃ. amatamadhigataṃ. ahamanusāsāmi. ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.16.6: yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ
pli-tv-kd1:6.16.7: brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe’va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.16.8: asakkhi kho bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū saññāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:6.16.9: atha kho pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ sussūsiṃsu. sotaṃ odahiṃsu. aññāya cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:6.17.1: atha kho bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:6.17.4: yo cā’yaṃ kāmesu kāmasukhallikānuyogo hīno gammo pothujjaniko anariyo anatthasaṃhito; yo cā’yaṃ attakilamathānuyogo dukkho anariyo anatthasaṃhito.
pli-tv-kd1:6.17.5: ete te bhikkhave ubho ante anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.”
pli-tv-kd1:6.18.1: “katamā ca sā bhikkhave, majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati?
pli-tv-kd1:6.18.3: sammādiṭṭhi, sammāsaṅkappo, sammāvācā, sammākammanto, sammāājīvo, sammāvāyāmo, sammāsati, sammāsamādhi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.18.4: ayaṃ kho sā, bhikkhave, majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā, cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.”
pli-tv-kd1:6.19.2: jāti’pi dukkhā. jarā’pi dukkhā, vyādhi’pi dukkho. maraṇampi dukkhaṃ. appiyehi sampayogo dukkho. piyehi vippayogo dukkho. yampicchaṃ na labhati, tampi dukkhaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:6.20.2: yā’yaṃ taṇhā ponobhavikā nandirāgasahagatā tatra tatrābhinandinī, seyyathidaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:6.21.2: yo tassāyeva taṇhāya asesavirāganirodho cāgo paṭinissaggo mutti anālayo.”
pli-tv-kd1:6.22.1: “idaṃ kho pana bhikkhave dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:6.23.1: “idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccanti me, bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi. ñāṇaṃ udapādi. paññā udapādi. vijjā udapādi. āloko udapādi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.23.2: taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ pariññeyyanti me bhikkhave …pe…
pli-tv-kd1:6.23.3: pariññātanti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi. ñāṇaṃ udapādi. paññā udapādi. vijjā udapādi. āloko udapādi.”
pli-tv-kd1:6.24.1: “idaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccanti me bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi. ñāṇaṃ udapādi. paññā udapādi. vijjā udapādi. āloko udapādi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.24.2: taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ pahātabbanti me bhikkhave …pe…
pli-tv-kd1:6.24.3: pahīṇanti me bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi. ñāṇaṃ udapādi. paññā udapādi. vijjā udapādi. āloko udapādi.”
pli-tv-kd1:6.25.1: “idaṃ dukkhanirodhaṃ ariyasaccanti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi. ñāṇaṃ udapādi. paññā udapādi. vijjā udapādi. āloko udapādi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.25.2: taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhanirodhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ sacchikātabbanti me bhikkhave …pe…
pli-tv-kd1:6.25.3: sacchikatanti me bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi …pe… āloko udapādi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.26.1: “idaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccanti me bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi …pe… āloko udapādi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.26.2: taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāariyasaccaṃ bhāvetabbanti me bhikkhave …pe…
pli-tv-kd1:6.26.3: bhāvitanti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi. ñāṇaṃ udapādi. paññā udapādi. vijjā udapādi. āloko udapādi.”
pli-tv-kd1:6.27.1: “yāvakīvañca me bhikkhave, imesu catusu ariyasaccesu evaṃ tiparivaṭṭaṃ dvādasākāraṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ na suvisuddhaṃ ahosi, neva nāvā’haṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammā sambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:6.28.1: “yato ca kho me bhikkhave, imesu catūsu ariyasaccesu evaṃ tiparivaṭṭaṃ dvādasākāraṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ ahosi athāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ
pli-tv-kd1:6.29.2: ‘akuppā me cetovimutti ayamantimā jāti natthidāni punabbhavo’ti.”
pli-tv-kd1:6.29.4: imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne āyasmato koṇḍaññassa virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi:
pli-tv-kd1:6.30.1: pavattite ca pana bhagavatā dhammacakke bhummā devā saddamanussāvesuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:6.30.2: “etaṃ bhagavatā bārāṇasiyaṃ isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ appativattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmi”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.30.3: bhummānaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā cātummahārājikā devā saddamanussāvesuṃ …pe…
pli-tv-kd1:6.30.4: cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā tāvatiṃsā devā -
pli-tv-kd1:6.30.10: “etaṃ bhagavatā bārāṇasiyaṃ isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ appativattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmi”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.31.1: itiha tena khaṇena tena muhuttena yāva brahmalokā saddo abbhuggañchi. ayaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:6.31.2: ca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṅkampi. sampakampi sampavedhi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.31.3: appamāṇo ca uḷāro obhāso loke pāturahosi atikkamma devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:6.31.5: “aññāsi vata bho koṇḍañño. aññāsi vata bho koṇḍañño”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.31.6: iti hi’daṃ āyasmato koṇḍaññassa ‘aññāsikoṇḍañño’ tve va nāmaṃ ahosi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.32.1: “atha kho āyasmā aññākoṇḍañño diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:6.32.2: “labheyyā’haṃ bhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ. labheyyaṃ upasampada”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.32.4: “svākkhāto dhammo. cara brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.33.1: atha kho bhagavā tadavasese bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya ovadi anusāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.33.2: atha kho āyasmato ca vappassa āyasmato ca bhaddiyassa bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya ovadiyamānānaṃ anusāsiyamānānaṃ virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi:
pli-tv-kd1:6.34.1: te diṭṭhadhammā pattadhammā viditadhammā pariyogāḷhadhammā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṅkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:6.34.2: “labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyāma upasampada”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.34.4: “svākkhāto dhammo. caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.35.1: atha kho bhagavā tadavasese bhikkhū nīhārabhatto dhammiyā kathāya ovadi anusāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:6.35.2: yaṃ tayo bhikkhū piṇḍāya caritvā āharanti, tena chabbaggo yāpeti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.36.1: atha kho āyasmato ca mahānāmassa āyasmato ca assajissa bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya ovadiyamānānaṃ anusāsiyamānānaṃ. virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi:
pli-tv-kd1:6.36.2: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamma”nti .
pli-tv-kd1:6.37.1: te diṭṭhadhammā pattadhammā viditadhammā pariyogāḷhadhammā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṅkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:6.37.2: “labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ. labheyyāma upasampada”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.37.4: “svākkhāto dhammo. caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.38.1: atha kho bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:6.38.3: rūpaṃ ca hidaṃ bhikkhave, attā abhavissa, nayidaṃ rūpaṃ ābādhāya saṃvatteyya. labbhetha ca rūpe
pli-tv-kd1:6.38.4: ‘evaṃ me rūpaṃ hotu, evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosī’ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.38.5: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, rūpaṃ anattā, tasmā rūpaṃ ābādhāya saṃvattati. na ca labbhati rūpe
pli-tv-kd1:6.38.6: ‘evaṃ me rūpaṃ hotu. evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosī’ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.39.2: vedanā ca hidaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissa, nayidaṃ vedanā ābādhāya saṃvatteyya. labbhetha ca vedanāya
pli-tv-kd1:6.39.3: ‘evaṃ me vedanā hotu. evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosī’ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.39.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, vedanā anattā, tasmā vedanā ābādhāya saṃvattati. na ca labbhati vedanāya
pli-tv-kd1:6.39.5: ‘evaṃ me vedanā hotu. evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosī’ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.40.7: saṅkhārā ca hidaṃ bhikkhave, attā abhavissiṃsu, nayime saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvatteyyuṃ. labbhetha ca saṅkhāresu
pli-tv-kd1:6.40.8: ‘evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu. evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesu’nti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.40.9: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, saṅkhārā anattā, tasmā saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvattanti. na ca labbhati saṅkhāresu
pli-tv-kd1:6.40.10: “evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu. evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesu’nti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.41.2: viññāṇañcahidaṃ bhikkhave, attā abhavissa, nayidaṃ viññāṇaṃ ābādhāya saṃvatteyya, labbhetha ca viññāṇe
pli-tv-kd1:6.41.3: ‘evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ hotu, evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ mā ahosī’ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.41.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ anattā, tasmā viññāṇaṃ ābādhāya saṃvattati, na ca labbhati viññāṇe
pli-tv-kd1:6.41.5: ‘evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ hotu. evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ mā ahosī’ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.42.1: “taṃ kimmaññatha bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā?ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.42.3: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā?ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.42.5: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ
pli-tv-kd1:6.43.24: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā?ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.43.26: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ
pli-tv-kd1:6.43.27: ‘etaṃ mama. eso hamasmi. eso me attā?’ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.44.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā, yaṃ dūre santike vā; sabbaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:6.44.2: netaṃ mama. neso’hamasmi, na me so attā’ti
pli-tv-kd1:6.45.10: yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikā vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre vā santike vā sabbaṃ taṃ viññāṇaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:6.45.11: netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na me so attā’ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.46.1: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmimpi nibbindati, vedanāya’pi nibbindati, saññāya’pi nibbindati. saṅkhāresu’pi nibbindati. viññāṇasmimpi nibbindati.
pli-tv-kd1:6.46.4: vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti; khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ; kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ; nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:6.47.2: attamanā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanduṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:6.47.3: imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne pañcavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:6.47.4: tena kho pana samayena cha loke arahanto honti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bārāṇasiyaṃ yaso nāma kulaputto seṭṭhiputto sukhumālo hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.1.3: eko hemantiko, eko gimhiko, eko vassiko.
pli-tv-kd1:7.1.4: so vassike pāsāde vassike cattāro māse nippurisehi turiyehi paricārayamāno na heṭṭhāpāsādaṃ orohati.
pli-tv-kd1:7.2.1: atha kho yasassa kulaputtassa pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitassa samaṅgībhūtassa paricārayamānassa paṭigacceva niddā okkami. parijanassa’pi niddā okkami, sabbarattiyo ca telappadīpo jhāyati.
pli-tv-kd1:7.2.2: atha kho yaso kulaputto paṭigacceva pabujjhitvā addasa sakaṃ parijanaṃ supantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:7.2.3: aññissā kacche vīṇaṃ. aññissā kaṇṭhe mudiṅgaṃ. aññissā kacche ālambaraṃ, aññaṃ vikkesikaṃ aññaṃ vikkheḷikaṃ. aññā vippalapantiyo. hatthappattaṃ susānaṃ maññe.
pli-tv-kd1:7.2.4: disvānassa ādīnavo pāturahosi. nibbidāya cittaṃ saṇṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:7.2.5: atha kho yaso kulaputto udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd1:7.3.1: atha kho yaso kulaputto suvaṇṇapādukāyo ārohitvā yena nivesanadvāraṃ tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-kd1:7.3.3: “mā yasassa kulaputtassa koci antarāyamakāsi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā”ti .
pli-tv-kd1:7.3.4: atha kho yaso kulaputto yena nagaradvāraṃ tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-kd1:7.3.6: “mā yasassa kulaputtassa koci antarāyamakāsi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.3.7: atha kho yaso kulaputto yena isipatanaṃ migadāyo, tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-kd1:7.4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya ajjhokāse caṅkamati.
pli-tv-kd1:7.4.2: addasā kho bhagavā yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ dūrato’va āgacchantaṃ. disvāna caṅkamā orohitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:7.4.3: atha kho yaso kulaputto bhagavato avidūre udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd1:7.4.4: upaddutaṃ vata bho; upassaṭṭhaṃ vata bho”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.4.5: atha kho bhagavā yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:7.4.7: ehi yasa, nisīda. dhammaṃ te desessāmī”ti
pli-tv-kd1:7.5.2: “idaṃ kira anupaddutaṃ. idaṃ anupassaṭṭha”nti haṭṭho udaggo suvaṇṇapādukāhi orohitvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:7.5.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnassa kho yasassa kulaputtassa bhagavā ānupubbīkathaṃ kathesi. seyyathidaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:7.5.4: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
pli-tv-kd1:7.6.1: yadā bhagavā aññāsi yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi –
pli-tv-kd1:7.6.3: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ paṭigaṇheyya,
pli-tv-kd1:7.6.4: evameva yasassa kulaputtassa tasmiṃyeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
pli-tv-kd1:7.7.1: atha kho yasassa kulaputtassa mātā pāsādaṃ abhiruhitvā yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ apassantī yena seṭṭhi gahapati, tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā seṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:7.7.3: atha kho seṭṭhi gahapati catuddisā assadūte uyyojetvā sāmaṃyeva yena isipatanaṃ migadāyo tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-kd1:7.7.4: addasā kho seṭṭhi gahapati suvaṇṇapādukānaṃ nikkhepaṃ. disvāna taññeva anugamā.
pli-tv-kd1:7.8.1: addasā kho bhagavā seṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ dūrato’va āgacchantaṃ, disvāna bhagavato etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:7.8.2: “yannūnāhaṃ tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhareyyaṃ, yathā seṭṭhi gahapati idha nisinno idha nisinnaṃ yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ na passeyyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.8.3: atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:7.9.1: atha kho seṭṭhi gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:7.9.3: tena hi gahapati, nisīda. appeva nāma idha nisinno idha nisinnaṃ yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ passeyyāsī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.9.5: “idheva kirāhaṃ nisinno idha nisinnaṃ yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ passissāmī” ti haṭṭho udaggo bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:7.10.1: ekamantaṃ nisinnassa kho seṭṭhissa gahapatissa bhagavā anupubbīkathaṃ kathesi …pe…
pli-tv-kd1:7.10.10: seyyathāpi bhante, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya
pli-tv-kd1:7.10.13: esāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
pli-tv-kd1:7.10.14: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gata”nti .
pli-tv-kd1:7.10.15: so’va loke paṭhamaṃ upāsako ahosi tevāciko.
pli-tv-kd1:7.11.1: atha kho yasassa kulaputtassa pituno dhamme desiyamāne yathādiṭṭhaṃ yathāviditaṃ bhūmiṃ paccavekkhantassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucci.
pli-tv-kd1:7.11.3: “yasassa kho kulaputtassa pituno dhamme desiyamāne yathādiṭṭhaṃ yathāviditaṃ bhūmiṃ paccavekkhantassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:7.11.4: abhabbo kho yaso kulaputto hīnāyāvattitvā kāme paribhuñjituṃ seyyathāpi pubbe agārikabhūto.
pli-tv-kd1:7.11.6: atha kho bhagavā taṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ paṭippassambhesi.
pli-tv-kd1:7.12.1: addasā kho seṭṭhi gahapati yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ nisinnaṃ. disvāna yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:7.12.2: “mātā te tāta, yasa, paridevasokasamāpannā. dehi mātuyā jīvita”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.13.1: atha kho yaso kulaputto bhagavantaṃ ullokesi.
pli-tv-kd1:7.13.2: atha kho bhagavā seṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:7.13.3: “taṃ kimmaññasi gahapati, yasassa sekhena ñāṇena sekhena dassanena dhammo diṭṭho vidito seyyathāpi tayā. tassa yathādiṭṭhaṃ yathāviditaṃ bhūmiṃ paccavekkhantassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:7.13.4: bhabbo nu kho so gahapati, hīnāyāvattitvā kāme paribhuñjituṃ seyyathāpi pubbe agārikabhūto?”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.13.6: “yasassa kho gahapati, kulaputtassa sekhena ñāṇena sekhena dassanena dhammo diṭṭho vidito seyyathāpi tayā. tassa yathādiṭṭhaṃ yathāviditaṃ bhūmiṃ paccavekkhantassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:7.13.7: abhabbo kho gahapati, yaso kulaputto hīnāyāvattitvā kāme paribhuñjituṃ seyyathāpi pubbe agārikabhūto”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.14.1: “lābhā bhante, yasassa kulaputtassa, suladdhaṃ bhante, yasassa kulaputtassa, yathā yasassa kulaputtassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:7.14.2: adhivāsetu me bhante, bhagavā ajjatanāya bhattaṃ yasena kulaputtena pacchāsamaṇenā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.14.4: atha kho seṭṭhi gahapati bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:7.15.1: atha kho yaso kulaputto acirapakkante seṭṭhimhi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:7.15.2: “labheyyā’ haṃ bhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ. labheyyaṃ upasampada”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.15.4: “svākkhāto dhammo. cara brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:7.15.6: tena kho pana samayena satta loke arahanto honti.
pli-tv-kd1:8.1.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya āyasmatā yasena pacchāsamaṇena yena seṭṭhissa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ, tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:8.1.2: atha kho āyasmato yasassa mātā ca purāṇadutiyikā ca yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:8.2.2: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ nekkhamme ca ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
pli-tv-kd1:8.2.3: yadā tā bhagavā aññāsi kallacittā muducittā vinīvaraṇacittā udaggacittā pasannacittā, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā, taṃ pakāsesi:
pli-tv-kd1:8.2.5: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ patigaṇheyya,
pli-tv-kd1:8.2.6: evameva tāsaṃ tasmiṃyeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi:
pli-tv-kd1:8.2.7: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamma”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:8.3.1: tā diṭṭhadhammā pattadhammā viditadhammā pariyogāḷhadhammā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṅkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:8.3.3: etā mayaṃ bhante, bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
pli-tv-kd1:8.3.4: upāsikāyo no bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:8.3.5: tā ca loke paṭhamaṃ upāsikā ahesuṃ tevācikā.
pli-tv-kd1:8.4.1: atha kho āyasmato yasassa mātā ca pitā ca purāṇadutiyikā ca bhagavantañca āyasmantañca yasaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:8.4.2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato yasassa mātarañca pitarañca purāṇadutiyikañca dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.

pli-tv-kd1:9.1.3: “yaso kira kulaputto kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:9.1.5: “naha nūna so orako dhammavinayo, na sā orakā pabbajjā, yattha yaso kulaputto kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:9.2.1: te yenāyasmā yaso, tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ yasaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:9.2.2: atha kho āyasmā yaso te cattāro gihisahāyake ādāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.

pli-tv-kd1:11.1.2: “muttā’haṃ, bhikkhave, sabbapāsehi ye dibbā ye ca mānusā.
pli-tv-kd1:11.1.3: tumhe’pi, bhikkhave, muttā sabbapāsehi ye dibbā ye ca mānusā.
pli-tv-kd1:11.1.4: caratha bhikkhave, cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:11.1.6: desetha bhikkhave, dhammaṃ ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetha.
pli-tv-kd1:11.1.7: santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā; assavaṇatā dhammassa parihāyanti, bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro.
pli-tv-kd1:11.1.8: ahampi bhikkhave, yena uruvelā senāninigamo, tenupasaṅkamissāmi dhammadesanāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:11.2.1: atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
pli-tv-kd1:11.2.19: “jānāti maṃ bhagavā. jānāti maṃ sugato”ti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyī ti.
pli-tv-kd1:12.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū nānādisā nānājanapadā pabbajjāpekhe upasampadāpekhe ānenti:
pli-tv-kd1:12.1.3: tattha bhikkhū ceva kilamanti pabbajjāpekhā ca upasampadāpekhā ca.
pli-tv-kd1:12.1.4: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd1:12.1.5: “etarahi kho bhikkhū nānādisā nānājanapadā pabbajjāpekhe upasampadāpekhe ānenti.
pli-tv-kd1:12.1.7: tattha bhikkhū ceva kilamanti, pabbajjāpekhā ca upasampadāpekhā ca.
pli-tv-kd1:12.1.9: “tumheva’dāni bhikkhave, tāsu tāsu disāsu tesu tesu janapadesu pabbājetha upasampādethā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:12.2.1: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:12.2.2: “idha mayhaṃ bhikkhave rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd1:12.2.3: ‘etarahi kho bhikkhū nānādisā nānājanapadā pabbajjāpekhe upasampadāpekhe ca ānenti -
pli-tv-kd1:12.2.4: bhagavā ne pabbājessati, upasampādessatī ti. tattha bhikkhū ceva kilamanti pabbajjāpekhā ca upasampadāpekhā ca.
pli-tv-kd1:12.3.1: yannūnāhaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anujāneyyaṃtumheva’dāni bhikkhave tāsu tāsu disāsu tesu tesu janapadesu pabbājetha upasampādethā”ti. anujānāmi bhikkhave, tumheva’dāni tāsu tāsu disāsu tesu tesu janapadesu pabbājetha. upasampādethāti.
pli-tv-kd1:12.3.3: paṭhamaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ kārāpetvā bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vandāpetvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdāpetvā, añjaliṃ paggaṇhāpetvā, evaṃ vadehīti vattabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:12.4.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave, imehi tīhi saraṇagamanehi pabbajjaṃ upasampadanti.
pli-tv-kd1:13.1.1: atha kho bhagavā vassaṃ vuttho bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:13.1.2: “mayhaṃ kho bhikkhave, yoniso manasikārā yoniso sammappadhānā anuttarā vimutti anuppattā. anuttarā vimutti sacchikatā.
pli-tv-kd1:13.1.3: tumhe’pi bhikkhave, yoniso manasikārā yoniso sammappadhānā anuttaraṃ vimuttiṃ anupāpuṇātha. anuttaraṃ vimuttiṃ sacchikarothā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:13.2.1: atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:-
pli-tv-kd1:13.2.11: “jānāti maṃ bhagavā, jānāti maṃ sugato”ti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyi.
pli-tv-kd1:14.1.1: atha kho bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena uruvelā tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:14.1.2: atha kho bhagavā maggā okkamma yena aññataro vanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:14.1.3: tena kho pana samayena tiṃsamattā bhaddavaggiyā sahāyakā sapajāpatikā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe paricārenti.
pli-tv-kd1:14.1.6: atha kho sā vesī tesu pamattesu paricārentesu bhaṇḍaṃ ādāya palāyittha.
pli-tv-kd1:14.2.1: atha kho te sahāyakā sahāyakassa veyyāvaccaṃ karontā taṃ itthiṃ gavesantā taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ āhiṇḍantā addasaṃsu bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:14.2.2: disvāna yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ: etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:14.2.5: idha mayaṃ bhante, tiṃsamattā bhaddavaggiyā sahāyakā sapajāpatikā imasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe paricārimhā.
pli-tv-kd1:14.2.8: atha kho sā bhante, vesī amhesu pamattesu paricārentesu bhaṇḍaṃ ādāya palāyittha.
pli-tv-kd1:14.2.9: te mayaṃ, bhante, sahāyakā sahāyakassa veyyāvaccaṃ karontā, taṃ itthiṃ gavesantā, imaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ āhiṇḍāmā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:14.3.1: “taṃ kiṃ maññatha vo kumārā, - katamaṃ nu kho tumhākaṃ varaṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:14.3.2: yaṃ vā tumhe itthiṃ gaveseyyātha, yaṃ vā attānaṃ gaveseyyāthā?”ti
pli-tv-kd1:14.3.3: “etadeva bhante, amhākaṃ varaṃ, - yaṃ mayaṃ attānaṃ gaveseyyāmā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:14.3.4: “tena hi vo kumārā, nisīdatha. dhammaṃ vo desissāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:14.3.5: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho te bhaddavaggiyā sahāyakā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:14.4.2: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ nekkhamme ca ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi
pli-tv-kd1:14.4.3: yadā te bhagavā aññāsi kallacitte muducitte vinīvaraṇacitte udaggacitte pasannacitte, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi: dukkhaṃ samudayaṃ nirodhaṃ maggaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:14.4.4: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ patigaṇheyya,
pli-tv-kd1:14.4.5: evameva tesaṃ tasmiṃyeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi:
pli-tv-kd1:14.5.1: te diṭṭhadhammā pattadhammā viditadhammā pariyogāḷhadhammā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṅkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:14.5.2: “labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ. labheyyāma upasampada”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:14.5.4: “svākkhāto dhammo. caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.1.1: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena uruvelā tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd1:15.1.2: tena kho pana samayena uruvelāyaṃ tayo jaṭilā paṭivasanti:
pli-tv-kd1:15.1.4: tesu uruvelakassapo jaṭilo pañcannaṃ jaṭilasatānaṃ nāyako hoti vināyako aggo pamukho pāmokkho.
pli-tv-kd1:15.1.5: nadīkassapo jaṭilo tiṇṇaṃ jaṭilasatānaṃ nāyako hoti. vināyako aggo pamukho pāmokkho.
pli-tv-kd1:15.1.6: gayākassapo jaṭilo dvinnaṃ jaṭilasatānaṃ nāyako hoti vināyako aggo pamukho pāmokkho.
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.1: atha kho bhagavā yena uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa assamo tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.2: “sace te kassapa, agaru, vaseyyāma ekarattiṃ agyāgāre”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.3: “na kho me mahāsamaṇa, garu. caṇḍettha nāgarājā iddhimā āsīviso ghoraviso. so taṃ mā viheṭhesī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.4: dutiyampi kho bhagavā uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.5: “sace te kassapa, agaru, vaseyyāma ekarattiṃ agyāgāre”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.6: “na kho me mahāsamaṇa, garu. caṇḍettha nāgarājā iddhimā āsīviso ghoraviso, so taṃ mā viheṭhesī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.7: tatiyampi kho bhagavā uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.8: “sace te, kassapa, agaru, vaseyyāma ekarattiṃ agyāgāre”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.9: “na kho me mahāsamaṇa, garu caṇḍettha nāgarājā iddhimā āsīviso. so taṃ mā viheṭhesī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.2.10: “appeva nāma maṃ na viheṭheyya, iṅgha tvaṃ kassapa, anujānāhi agyāgāra”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.3.1: atha kho bhagavā agyāgāraṃ pavisitvā tiṇasantharakaṃ paññapetvā nisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
pli-tv-kd1:15.3.2: atha kho so nāgo addasa bhagavantaṃ paviṭṭhaṃ. disvāna dummano padhūpāyi.
pli-tv-kd1:15.3.4: “yannūnāhaṃ imassa nāgassa anupahacca chaviñca cammañca maṃsañca nahāruñca aṭṭhiñca aṭṭhimiñjañca tejasā tejaṃ pariyādiyeyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.4.1: atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā padhūpāyi.
pli-tv-kd1:15.4.2: atha kho so nāgo dukkhaṃ asahamāno pajjali.
pli-tv-kd1:15.4.4: ubhinnaṃ sajotibhūtānaṃ agyāgāraṃ ādittaṃ viya hoti sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:15.4.5: atha kho te jaṭilā agyāgāraṃ parivāretvā evamāhaṃsu:
pli-tv-kd1:15.5.1: atha kho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena tassa nāgassa anupahacca chaviñca cammañca maṃsañca nahāruñca aṭṭhiñca aṭṭhimiñjañca tejasā tejaṃ pariyādiyitvā patte pakkhipitvā uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa dassesi:
pli-tv-kd1:15.5.2: “ayaṃ te kassapa, nāgo. pariyādinno assa tejasā tejo”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.5.4: “mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo. yatra hi nāma caṇḍassa nāgarājassa iddhimato āsīvisassa ghoravisassa tejasā tejaṃ pariyādiyissati. natveva ca kho arahā yathā aha”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:15.7.13: atha kho uruvelakassapo jaṭilo bhagavato iminā iddhipāṭihāriyena abhippasanno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:16.1.1: atha kho bhagavā uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa assamassa avidūre aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe vihāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:16.1.2: atha kho cattāro mahārājā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā catuddisā aṭṭhaṃsu seyyathāpi mahantā aggikkhandhā.
pli-tv-kd1:16.2.1: atha kho uruvelakassapo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:16.2.3: ke nu kho te mahāsamaṇa abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ obhāsetvā yena tvaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu? upasaṅkamitvā taṃ abhivādetvā catuddisā aṭṭhaṃsu seyyathāpi mahantā aggikkhandhā?”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:16.2.4: “ete kho kassapa, cattāro mahārājā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu dhammassavanāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:16.2.6: “mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma cattāropi mahārājā upasaṅkamissanti dhammassavaṇāya. natveva ca kho arahā yathā aha”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:16.2.7: atha kho bhagavā uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñjitvā tasmiṃyeva vanasaṇḍe vihāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:17.1.1: atha kho sakko devānamindo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi seyyathāpi mahāaggikkhandho, purimāhi vaṇṇanibhāhi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
pli-tv-kd1:17.2.1: atha kho uruvelakassapo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:17.2.3: ko nu kho so mahāsamaṇa, abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ obhāsetvā yena tvaṃ tenupasaṅkami? upasaṅkamitvā taṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi seyyathāpi mahāaggikkhandho purimāhi vaṇṇanibhāhi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca?”
pli-tv-kd1:17.2.4: “eso kho kassapa, sakko devānamindo yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami dhammassavaṇāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:17.2.6: “mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma sakkopidevānamindo upasaṅkamissati dhammassavaṇāya, natveva ca kho arahā yathā aha”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:17.2.7: atha kho bhagavā uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñjitvā tasmiṃyeva vanasaṇḍe vihāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:18.1.1: atha kho brahmā sahampati abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi seyyathāpi mahāaggikkhandho, purimāhi vaṇṇanibhāhi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
pli-tv-kd1:18.2.1: atha kho uruvelakassapo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:18.2.3: ko nu kho so mahāsamaṇa, abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ obhāsetvā yena tvaṃ tenupasaṅkami? upasaṅkamitvā taṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi seyyathāpi mahā aggikkhandho purimāhi vaṇṇanibhāhi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā?”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:18.2.4: “eso kho kassapa, brahmā sahampati yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami dhammassavanāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:18.2.6: “mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma brahmāpi sahampati upasaṅkamissati dhammasavaṇāya, natveva ca kho arahā yathā aha”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:18.2.7: atha kho bhagavā uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñjitvā tasmiṃyeva vanasaṇḍe vihāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:19.1.1: tena kho pana samayena uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa mahāyañño paccupaṭṭhito hoti. kevalakappā ca aṅgamagadhā pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya abhikkamitukāmā honti.
pli-tv-kd1:19.1.3: “etarahi kho me mahāyañño paccupaṭṭhito. kevalakappā ca aṅgamagadhā pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya abhikkamissanti.
pli-tv-kd1:19.1.4: sace mahāsamaṇo mahājanakāye iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissati, mahāsamaṇassa lābhasakkāro abhivaḍḍhissati. mama lābhasakkāro parihāyissati.
pli-tv-kd1:19.2.1: atha kho bhagavā uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya uttarakuruṃ gantvā tato piṇḍapātaṃ āharitvā anotattadahe paribhuñjitvā tattheva divāvihāraṃ akāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:19.2.2: atha kho uruvelakassapo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:19.2.7: khādanīyassa ca bhojanīyassa ca te paṭiviṃso ṭhapito”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:19.3.2: etarahi kho me mahāyañño paccupaṭṭhito, kevalakappā ca aṅgamagadhā pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya abhikkamissanti. sace mahāsamaṇo mahājanakāye iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissati, mahāsamaṇassa lābhasakkāro abhivaḍḍhissati. mama lābhasakkāro parihāyissati. aho nūna mahāsamaṇo svātanāya nāgaccheyyā?”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:19.4.1: “so kho ahaṃ kassapa, tava cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya uttarakuruṃ gantvā tato piṇḍapātaṃ āharitvā anotattadahe paribhuñjitvā tattheva divāvihāraṃ akāsi”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:19.4.3: “mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma cetasā’pi cittaṃ pajānissati, natveva ca kho arahā yathā aha”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:19.4.4: atha kho bhagavā uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñjitvā tasmiṃyeva vanasaṇḍe vihāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:20.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavato paṃsukūlaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.1.4: atha kho sakko devānamindo bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya pāṇinā pokkharaṇiṃ khaṇitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.1.8: atha kho sakko devānamindo bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya mahatiṃ silaṃ upanikkhipi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.2.3: atha kho kakudhe adhivatthā devatā bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya sākhaṃ onāmesi
pli-tv-kd1:20.2.7: atha kho sakko devānamindo bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya mahatiṃ silaṃ upanikkhipi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.3.1: atha kho uruvelakassapo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.3.3: kinnu kho mahāsamaṇa, nāyaṃ pubbe idha pokkharaṇī, sāyaṃ idha pokkharaṇī?
pli-tv-kd1:20.3.6: nayimassa kakudhassa pubbe sākhā onatā, sāyaṃ sākhā onatā?”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.4.1: idha me kassapa, paṃsukūlaṃ uppannaṃ ahosi.
pli-tv-kd1:20.4.4: atha kho kassapa, sakko devānamindo mama cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya pāṇinā pokkharaṇiṃ khaṇitvā maṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.4.9: atha kho kassapa, sakko devānamindo mama cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya mahatiṃ silaṃ upanikkhipi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.5.3: atha kho kassapa, kakudhe adhivatthā devatā ja mama cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya sākhaṃ onāmesi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.5.8: atha kho kassapa, sakko devānamindo mama cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya mahatiṃ silaṃ upanikkhipi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.6.2: “mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma sakkopi devānamindo veyyāvaccaṃ karissati. natveva ca kho arahā yathā aha”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.6.3: atha kho bhagavā uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñjitvā tasmiṃyeva vanasaṇḍe vihāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:20.7.1: atha kho uruvelakassapo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocesi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.7.3: “gaccha, kassapa, āyāmaha”nti uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ uyyojetvā yāya jambuyā jambudīpo paññāyati tato phalaṃ gahetvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgāre nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:20.8.1: addasā kho uruvelakassapo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ agyāgāre nisinnaṃ. disvāna bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.8.3: ahaṃ tayā paṭhamataraṃ pakkanto. so tvaṃ paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgāre nisinno”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.9.1: “idhāhaṃ kassapa, taṃ uyyojetvā yāya jambuyā jambudīpo paññāyati, tato phalaṃ gahetvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgāre nisinno.
pli-tv-kd1:20.9.2: idaṃ kho kassapa, jambuphalaṃ vaṇṇasampannaṃ gandhasampannaṃ rasasampannaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:20.9.4: “alaṃ, mahāsamaṇa, tvaṃ yevetaṃ aharasi, tvaṃ yevetaṃ paribhuñjā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.9.6: “mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo. yatra hi nāma maṃ paṭhamataraṃ uyyojetvā yāya jambuyā jambudīpo paññāyati, tato phalaṃ gahetvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgāre nisīdissati, natveva ca kho arahā yathā aha”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.9.7: atha kho bhagavā uruvelakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñjitvā tasmiṃyeva vanasaṇḍe vihāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:20.10.1: atha kho uruvelakassapo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocesi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.10.3: gaccha, kassapa, āyāmaha”nti uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ uyyojetvā yāya jambuyā jambudīpo paññāyati, tassā avidūre ambo …pe…
pli-tv-kd1:20.10.6: tāvatiṃsaṃ gantvā pāricchattakapupphaṃ gahetvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgāre nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:20.10.7: addasā kho uruvelakassapo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ agyāgāre nisinnaṃ. disvāna bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.10.9: ahaṃ tayā paṭhamataraṃ pakkanto. so tvaṃ paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgāre nisinno”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.11.1: “idhāhaṃ kassapa, taṃ uyyojetvā tāvatiṃsaṃ gantvā pāricchattakapupphaṃ gahetvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgāre nisinno.
pli-tv-kd1:20.11.2: idaṃ kho kassapa, pāricchattakapupphaṃ vaṇṇasampannaṃ gandhasampanna”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.11.6: “mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma maṃ paṭhamataraṃ uyyojetvā tāvatiṃsaṃ gantvā pāricchattakapupphaṃ gahetvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgāre nisīdissati. natveva ca kho arahā yathā aha”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.12.1: tena kho pana samayena te jaṭilā aggiṃ paricaritukāmā na sakkonti kaṭṭhāni phāletuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:20.12.3: “nissaṃsayaṃ kho mahāsamaṇassa iddhānubhāvo, yathā mayaṃ na sakkoma kaṭṭhāni phāletu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.12.4: atha kho bhagavā uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.12.9: “mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma kaṭṭhānipi phālīyissanti. natveva ca kho arahā yathā aha”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.13.1: tena kho pana samayena te jaṭilā aggiṃ paricaritukāmā na sakkonti aggiṃ jāletuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:20.13.3: “nissaṃsayaṃ kho mahāsamaṇassa iddhānubhāvo, yathā mayaṃ na sakkoma aggiṃ jāletu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.13.4: atha kho bhagavā uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.13.9: “mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma aggīpi ujjalīyissanti. natveva ca kho arahā yathā aha”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.14.1: tena kho pana samayena te jaṭilā aggiṃ paricaritvā na sakkonti aggiṃ vijjhāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:20.14.3: “nissaṃsayaṃ kho mahāsamaṇassa iddhānubhāvo, yathā mayaṃ na sakkoma aggiṃ vijjhāpetu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.14.4: atha kho bhagavā uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.14.9: “mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma aggīpi vijjhāyissanti. natveva ca kho arahā yathā aha”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.15.1: tena kho pana samayena te jaṭilā sītāsu hemantikāsu rattīsu antaraṭṭhakāsu himapātasamaye najjā nerañjarāya ummujjantipi’ nimujjantipi’ ummujjanimujjanampi karonti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.15.2: atha kho bhagavā pañcamattāni mandāmukhisatāni abhinimmini yattha te jaṭilā uttaritvā visīvesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:20.15.4: “nissaṃsayaṃ kho mahāsamaṇassa iddhānubhāvo, yathāyimā mandāmukhiyo nimmitā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.15.6: “mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma tāva bahū mandāmukhiyopi abhinimminissati, natveva ca kho arahā yathā aha”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.1: tena kho pana samayena mahā akālamegho pāvassi. mahā udakavāhako sañjāyi.
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.2: yasmiṃ padese bhagavā viharati, so padeso udakena otthaṭo hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.4: “yannūnāhaṃ samantā udakaṃ ussādetvā majjhe reṇugatāya bhūmiyā caṅkameyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.5: atha kho bhagavā samantā udakaṃ ussādetvā majjhe reṇugatāya bhūmiyā caṅkami.
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.7: “māheva kho mahāsamaṇo udakena vūḷho ahosī”ti nāvāya sambahulehi jaṭilehi saddhiṃ, yasmiṃ padese bhagavā viharati, taṃ padesaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.8: addasā kho uruvelakassapo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ samantā udakaṃ ussādetvā majjhe reṇugatāya bhūmiyā caṅkamantaṃ. disvāna bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.16.13: “mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma udakampi nappasahissati. natveva ca kho arahā yathā aha”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.17.3: ‘mahiddhiko kho mahāsamaṇo mahānubhāvo, natveva ca kho arahā yathā aha’nti;
pli-tv-kd1:20.17.5: atha kho bhagavā uruvelakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.17.6: “neva ca kho tvaṃ kassapa, arahā. nāpi arahattamaggaṃ samāpanno.
pli-tv-kd1:20.17.7: sāpi te paṭipadā natthi, yāya tvaṃ arahā vā assasi arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpanno”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.17.8: atha kho uruvelakassapo jaṭilo bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.17.9: “labheyyāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampada”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.18.1: “tvaṃ kho’si kassapa, pañcannaṃ jaṭilasatānaṃ nāyako vināyako aggo pamukho pāmokkho.
pli-tv-kd1:20.18.2: tepi tāva apalokehi, yathā te maññissanti tathā karissantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.18.3: atha kho uruvelakassapo jaṭilo yena te jaṭilā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā te jaṭile etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.18.4: “icchāmahaṃ bho mahāsamaṇe brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ. yathā bhavanto maññanti, tathā karontū”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.18.5: “cirapaṭikā mayaṃ bho, mahāsamaṇe abhippasannā, sace bhavaṃ mahāsamaṇe brahmacariyaṃ carissati, sabbeva mayaṃ mahāsamaṇe brahmacariyaṃ carissāmā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.19.1: atha kho te jaṭilā kesamissaṃ jaṭāmissaṃ khārikājamissaṃ aggihuttamissaṃ udake pavāhetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:20.19.2: “labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyāma upasampada”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.19.4: “svākkhāto dhammo. caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.20.1: addasā kho nadīkassapo jaṭilo kesamissaṃ jaṭāmissaṃ khārikājamissaṃ aggihuttamissaṃ udake vuyhamāne. disvānassa etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.20.5: sāmañca tīhi jaṭilasatehi yenāyasmā uruvelakassapo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ uruvelakassapaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.21.1: atha kho te jaṭilā kesamissaṃ jaṭāmissaṃ khārikājamissaṃ aggihuttamissaṃ udake pavāhetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:20.21.2: “labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyāma upasampada”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.21.4: “svākkhāto dhammo caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.22.1: addasā kho gayākassapo jaṭilo kesamissaṃ jaṭāmissaṃ khārikājamissaṃ aggihuttamissaṃ udake vuyhamāne. disvānassa etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:20.22.5: sāmañca dvīhi jaṭilasatehi saddhiṃ yenāyasmā uruvelakassapo, tenupasaṃkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ uruvelakassapaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:20.23.1: atha kho te jaṭilā kesamissaṃ jaṭāmissaṃ khārikājamissaṃ aggihuttamissaṃ udake pavāhetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:20.23.2: “labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ. labheyyāma upasampada”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:20.23.4: “svākkhāto dhammo. caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā”ti.
