pli-tv-kd1:37.13.1: aparehipi bhikkhave chahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na upasampādetabbaṃ. na nissayo dātabbo, na sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:37.13.2: āpattiṃ na jānāti. anāpattiṃ na jānāti. lahukaṃ āpattiṃ na jānāti. garukaṃ āpattiṃ na jānāti. ubhayāni kho panassa pātimokkhāni vitthārena na svāgatāni honti na suvibhattāni na suppavattīni na suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso. ūnadasavasso hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:37.13.3: imehi kho bhikkhave chahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na upasampādetabbaṃ. na nissayo dātabbo. na sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:37.14.1: chahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā upasampādetabbaṃ. nissayo dātabbo sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:37.14.2: āpattiṃ jānāti. anāpattiṃ jānāti. lahukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti garukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti. ubhayāni kho panassa pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso. dasavasso vā hoti atirekadasavasso vā.
pli-tv-kd1:37.14.3: imehi kho bhikkhave, chahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā upasampādetabbaṃ. nissayo dātabbo. sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo ti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.1.1: tena kho pana samayena yo so aññatitthiyapubbo upajjhāyena sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno upajjhāyassa vādaṃ āropetvā taṃyeva titthāyatanaṃ saṅkami.
pli-tv-kd1:38.1.2: so puna paccāgantvā bhikkhū upasampadaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-kd1:38.1.4: “yo so bhikkhave, aññatitthiyapubbo upajjhāyena sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno upajjhāyassa vādaṃ āropetvā taṃyeva titthāyatanaṃ saṅkanto, so āgato na upasampādetabbo.”
pli-tv-kd1:38.1.5: yo bhikkhave aññopi aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ. tassa cattāro māse parivāso dātabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:38.2.2: paṭhamaṃ kesamassuṃ ohārāpetvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādāpetvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ kārāpetvā bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vandāpetvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdāpetvā añjalimpaggaṇhāpetvā evaṃ vadehī ti vattabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:38.3.1: tena bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbena saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjalimpaggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo.
pli-tv-kd1:38.3.2: “ahaṃ bhante, itthannāmo aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhāmi upasampadaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:38.3.3: sohambhante, saṅghaṃ cattāro māse parivāsaṃ yācāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.3.8: ayaṃ itthannāmo aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:38.3.9: so saṅghaṃ cattāro māse parivāsaṃ yācati.
pli-tv-kd1:38.3.10: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho itthannāmassa aññatitthiyapubbassa cattāro māse parivāsaṃ dadeyya.
pli-tv-kd1:38.4.2: ayaṃ itthannāmo aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:38.4.3: so saṅghaṃ cattāro māse parivāsaṃ yācati.
pli-tv-kd1:38.4.4: saṅgho itthannāmassa aññatitthiyapubbassa cattāro māse parivāsaṃ deti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.4.5: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa aññatitthiyapubbassa cattāro māse parivāsassa dānaṃ. so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-kd1:38.4.7: “dinno saṅghena itthannāmassa aññatitthiyapubbassa cattāro māse parivāso.
pli-tv-kd1:38.4.8: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.5.1: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, aññatitthiyapubbo ārādhako hoti evaṃ anārādhako.
pli-tv-kd1:38.5.3: idha bhikkhave, aññatitthiyapubbo atikālena gāmaṃ pavisati. atidivā paṭikkamati.
pli-tv-kd1:38.5.5: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, aññatitthiyapubbo vesiyāgocaro vā hoti. vidhavāgocaro vā hoti. thullakumārikāgocaro vā hoti. paṇḍakagocaro vā hoti. bhikkhunigocaro vā hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, aññatitthiyapubbo yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ uccāvacāni kiṅkaraṇīyāni tattha na dakkho hoti na analaso. na tatrūpāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato. na alaṃ kātuṃ, na alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ
pli-tv-kd1:38.6.3: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, aññatitthiyapubbo na tibbacchando hoti uddese paripucchāya, adhisīle, adhicitte, adhipaññāya.
pli-tv-kd1:38.7.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, aññatitthiyapubbo yassa titthāyatanā saṅkanto hoti, tassa satthuno tassa diṭṭhiyā tassa khantiyā tassa ruciyā tassa ādāyassa avaṇṇe bhaññamāne kupito hoti anattamano anabhiraddho. buddhassa vā dhammassa vā saṅghassa vā avaṇṇe bhaññamāne attamano hoti udaggo abhiraddho.
pli-tv-kd1:38.7.2: yassa vā pana titthāyatanā saṅkanto hoti, tassa satthuno tassa diṭṭhiyā tassa khantiyā tassa ruciyā tassa ādāyassa vaṇṇe bhaññamāne attamano hoti udaggo abhiraddho, buddhassa vā dhammassa vā saṅghassa vā vaṇṇe bhaññamāne kupito hoti anattamano anabhiraddho.
pli-tv-kd1:38.7.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, aññatitthiyapubbo anārādhako hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.7.5: evaṃ anārādhako kho bhikkhave, aññatitthiyapubbo āgato na upasampādetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:38.8.2: idha bhikkhave, aññatitthiyapubbo nātikālena gāmaṃ pavisati. nātidivā paṭikkamati.
pli-tv-kd1:38.8.4: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, aññatitthiyapubbo na vesiyāgocaro hoti. na vidhavāgocaro hoti. na thullakumārikāgocaro hoti. na paṇḍakagocaro hoti. na bhikkhunigocaro hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.9.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, aññatitthiyapubbo yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ uccāvacāni kiṅkaraṇīyāni, tattha dakkho hoti analaso. tatrūpāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:38.9.3: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave aññatitthiyapubbo tibbacchando hoti uddese paripucchāya, adhisīle, adhicitte, adhipaññāya.
pli-tv-kd1:38.10.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, aññatitthiyapubbo yassa titthāyatanā saṅkanto hoti, tassa satthuno tassa diṭṭhiyā tassa khantiyā tassa ruciyā tassa ādāyassa avaṇṇe bhaññamāne attamano hoti udaggo abhiraddho. buddhassa vā dhammassa vā saṅghassa vā avaṇṇe bhaññamāne kupito hoti anattamano anabhiraddho.
pli-tv-kd1:38.10.2: yassa vā pana titthāyatanā saṅkanto hoti, tassa satthuno tassa diṭṭhiyā tassa khantiyā tassa ruciyā tassa ādāyassa vaṇṇe bhaññamāne kupito hoti anattamano anabhiraddho. buddhassa vā dhammassa vā saṅghassa vā vaṇṇe bhaññamāne attamano hoti udaggo abhiraddho.
pli-tv-kd1:38.10.4: evampi kho bhikkhave, aññatitthiyapubbo ārādhako hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:38.10.5: evaṃ ārādhako kho, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyapubbo āgato upasampādetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:38.11.1: sace bhikkhave, aññatitthiyapubbo naggo āgacchati upajjhāyamūlakaṃ cīvaraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:38.11.2: sace acchinnakeso āgacchati saṅgho apaloketabbo bhaṇḍukammāya.
pli-tv-kd1:38.11.3: ye te bhikkhave, aggikā jaṭilakā te āgatā upasampādetabbā. na tesaṃ parivāso dātabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:38.11.6: sace bhikkhave jātiyā sākiyo, aññatitthiyapubbo āgacchati, so āgato upasampādetabbo. na tassa parivāso dātabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:38.11.7: imāhaṃ bhikkhave ñātīnaṃ āveṇikaṃ parihāraṃ dammī’ti.
pli-tv-kd1:39.1.1: tena kho pana samayena magadhesu pañca ābādhā ussannā honti:
pli-tv-kd1:39.1.3: manussā pañcahi ābādhehi phuṭṭhā jīvakaṃ komārabhaccaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadanti:
pli-tv-kd1:39.1.6: rājā ca me māgadho seniyo bimbisāro upaṭṭhātabbo, itthāgāraṃ ca, buddhappamukho ca saṅgho.
pli-tv-kd1:39.2.1: “ahamayyā, bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo. rājā ca. me māgadho seniyo bimbisāro upaṭṭhātabbo, itthāgārañca buddhapamukho ca saṅgho.
pli-tv-kd1:39.2.4: “ime kho samaṇā sakyaputtiyā sukhasīlā sukhasamācārā, subhojanāni bhuñjitvā nivātesu sayanesu sayanti.
pli-tv-kd1:39.2.6: tattha bhikkhū ceva upaṭṭhahissanti. jīvako ca komārabhacco tikicchissatī”ti .
pli-tv-kd1:39.2.7: atha kho te manussā bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāciṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:39.2.9: te bhikkhū ceva upaṭṭhahiṃsu. jīvako ca komārabhacco tikicchi.
pli-tv-kd1:39.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bahū gilāne bhikkhū upaṭṭhahantā yācanabahulā viññattibahulā viharanti.
pli-tv-kd1:39.3.3: jīvakopi komārabhacco bahū gilāne bhikkhū tikicchanto aññataraṃ rājakiccaṃ parihāpesi.
pli-tv-kd1:39.4.1: aññataro pi puriso pañcahi ābādhehi puṭṭho jīvakaṃ komārabhaccaṃ upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:39.4.3: “ahaṅkhavayyo bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo. rājā ca me māgadho seniyo bimbisāro upaṭṭhātabbo. itthāgāraṃ ca, buddhappamukho ca saṅgho.
pli-tv-kd1:39.4.5: “sabbaṃ sāpateyya ca te ācariya hotu. ahañca te dāso.
pli-tv-kd1:39.4.7: “ahaṅkhavayyo, bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo, rājā ca me māgadho seniyo bimbisāro upaṭṭhātabbo. itthāgāraṃ ca, buddhappamukho ca saṅgho. nāhaṃ sakkomi tikicchitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:39.5.2: “ime kho samaṇā sakyaputtiyā sukhasīlā sukhasamācārā, subhojanāni bhuñjitvā nivātesu sayanesu sayanti.
pli-tv-kd1:39.5.4: tattha bhikkhūceva upaṭṭhahissanti. jīvako ca komārabhacco tikicchissati.
pli-tv-kd1:39.5.6: atha kho so puriso bhikkhu upasaṅkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-kd1:39.5.8: taṃ bhikkhūceva upaṭṭhahiṃsu, jīvako ca komārabhacco tikicchi.
pli-tv-kd1:39.5.10: addasā kho jīvako komārabhacco taṃ purisaṃ vibbhantaṃ. disvāna taṃ purisaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:39.5.14: atha kho so puriso jīvakassa komārabhaccassa etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:39.6.2: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhadantā pañcahi ābādhehi phuṭṭhaṃ pabbājessantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:39.6.3: atha kho jīvako komārabhacco yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:39.6.4: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho jīvako komārabhacco bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:39.6.5: “sādhu bhante, ayyā pañcahi ābādhehi phuṭṭhaṃ na pabbājeyyu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:39.7.1: atha kho bhagavā jīvakaṃ komārabhaccaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi. samādapesi. samuttejesi. sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd1:39.7.2: atha kho jīvako komārabhacco bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:39.7.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:40.1.1: tena kho pana samayena rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa paccanto kupito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.1.2: atha kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro senānāyake mahāmatte āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd1:40.1.4: “evaṃ devā”ti kho senānāyakā mahāmattā rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa paccassosuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:40.2.1: atha kho abhiññātānaṃ abhiññātānaṃ yodhānaṃ etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:40.2.2: “mayaṃ kho yuddhābhinandino gacchantā pāpañca karoma. bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavāma.
pli-tv-kd1:40.2.3: kena nu kho mayaṃ upāyena pāpā ca virameyyāma kalyāṇañca kareyyāmā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.2.5: “ime kho samaṇā sakyaputtiyā dhammacārino samacārino brahmacārino saccavādino sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā.
pli-tv-kd1:40.2.6: sace kho mayaṃ samaṇesu sakyaputtiyesu pabbajeyyāma evaṃ mayaṃ pāpā ca virameyyāma kalyāṇañca kareyyāmā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.2.7: atha kho te yodhā bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāciṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:40.3.2: “kinnu kho bhaṇe itthannāmo ca itthannāmo ca yodhā na dissantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.3.3: “itthannāmo ca itthannāmo sāmi, yodhā bhikkhūsu pabbajitā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.3.5: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā rājabhaṭaṃ pabbājessantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.3.6: senānāyakā mahāmattā rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:40.3.7: atha kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro vohārike mahāmatte pucchi.
pli-tv-kd1:40.3.8: “yo bhaṇe, rājabhaṭaṃ pabbājeti, kiṃ so pasavatī?”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.3.9: upajjhāyassa deva, sīsaṃ chetabbaṃ. anusāsakassa jivhā uddharitabbā. gaṇassa upaḍḍhaphāsukā bhañjitabbā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.4.1: atha kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:40.4.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:40.4.5: sādhu bhante ayyā rājabhaṭaṃ na pabbājeyyu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:40.4.6: atha kho bhagavā rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ seniyaṃ bimbisāraṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi. samādapesi. samuttejesi. sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd1:40.4.7: atha kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:40.4.8: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:41.1.1: tena kho pana samayena coro aṅgulimālo bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:41.1.2: manussā passitvā ubbijjantipi. uttasanti pi. palāyantipi. aññenapi gacchanti. aññenapi mukhaṃ karonti. dvārampi thakenti.
pli-tv-kd1:41.1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā dhajabandhaṃ coraṃ pabbājessantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:41.1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:41.1.6: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ
pli-tv-kd1:42.1.1: tena kho pana samayena raññā māgadhena seniyena bimbisārena anuññātaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd1:42.1.2: “ye samaṇesu sakyaputtiyesu pabbajanti. na te labbhā kiñcikātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:42.1.3: svākkhāto dhammo carantu brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:42.1.4: tena kho pana samayena aññataro puriso corikaṃ katvā kārāya baddho hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:42.1.5: so kāraṃ bhinditvā palāyitvā bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:42.2.7: ye samaṇesu sakyaputtiyesu pabbajanti na te labbhā kiñci kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:42.2.8: svākkhāto dhammo. carantu brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:42.2.10: “abhayūvarā ime samaṇā sakyaputtiyā. nayime labbhā kiñci kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:42.2.11: kathaṃ hi nāma kārabhedakaṃ coraṃ pabbājessantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:43.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro puriso corikaṃ katvā palāyitvā bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:43.1.2: so ca rañño antepure likhito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:43.1.9: anuññātaṃ raññā māgadhena seniyena bimbisārena ye samaṇesu sakyaputtiyesu pabbajanti na te labbhā kiñci kātuṃ. svākkhāto dhammo. carantu brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:43.1.11: “abhayūvarā ime samaṇā sakyaputtiyā. nayime labbhā kiñci kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:43.1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma likhitakaṃ coraṃ pabbājessantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:44.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro puriso kasāhato katadaṇḍakammo bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:44.1.3: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā kasāhataṃ katadaṇḍakammaṃ pabbājessantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:45.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro puriso lakkhaṇāhato katadaṇḍakammo bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:45.1.3: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā lakkhaṇāhataṃ katadaṇḍakammaṃ pabbājessantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:46.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro puriso iṇāyiko palāyitvā bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:46.1.8: ye samaṇesu sakyaputtiyesu pabbajanti na te labbhā kiñci kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:46.1.9: svākkhāto dhammo carantu brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:47.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro dāso palāyitvā bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:47.1.6: “māyyā evaṃ avacuttha. anuññātaṃ raññā māgadhena seniyena bimbisārena ye samaṇesu sakyaputtiyesu pabbajanti na te labbhā kiñci kātuṃ. svākkhāto dhammo. carantu brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:47.1.8: “abhayūvarā ime samaṇā sakyaputtiyā. nayime labbhā kiñcikātuṃ. “kathaṃ
pli-tv-kd1:48.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro kammārabhaṇḍu mātāpitūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍitvā ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:48.1.2: atha kho tassa kammārabhaṇḍussa mātāpitaro taṃ kammārabhaṇḍuṃ vicinantā ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhū pucchiṃsu:
pli-tv-kd1:48.2.1: atha kho tassa kammārabhaṇḍussa mātāpitaro taṃ kammārabhaṇḍuṃ vicinantā bhikkhūsu pabbajitaṃ disvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd1:48.2.3: jānaṃyeva āhaṃsu na jānāmāti. passaṃyeva āhaṃsu na passāmāti.
pli-tv-kd1:48.2.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa kammārabhaṇḍussa mātāpitunnaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:48.2.6: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:49.1.1: tena kho pana samayena rājagahe sattarasavaggiyā dārakā sahāyakā honti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.1.4: “kena nu kho upāyena upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañca jīveyya na ca kilameyyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.1.6: “sace kho upāli lekhaṃ sikkheyya, evaṃ kho upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañca jīveyya na ca kilameyyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.1.8: “sace kho upāli lekhaṃ sikkhissati, aṃguliyo dukkhā bhavissanti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.1.9: sace kho upāli gaṇanaṃ sikkheyya, evaṃ kho upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañca jīveyya na ca kilameyyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.2.1: “sace kho upāli gaṇanaṃ sikkhissati, urassa dukkho bhavissati.
pli-tv-kd1:49.2.2: sace kho upāli rūpaṃ sikkheyya, evaṃ kho upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañca jīveyya na ca kilameyyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.2.4: “sace kho upāli rūpaṃ sikkhissati, akkhīni dukkhā bhavissanti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.2.5: “ime kho samaṇā sakyaputtiyā sukhasīlā sukhasamācārā, subhojanāni bhuñjitvā nivātesu sayanesu sayanti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.2.6: sace kho upāli samaṇesu sakyaputtiyesu pabbajeyya, evaṃ kho upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañca jīveyya, na ca kilameyyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.3.1: assosi kho upāli dārako mātāpitunnaṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:49.3.2: atha kho upāli dārako yena te dārakā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā te dārake etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:49.3.5: atha kho te dārakā ekamekassa mātāpitaro upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-kd1:49.4.5: sace yāgu bhavissatī. pivissatha, sace bhattaṃ bhavissati bhuñjissatha, sace khādanīyaṃ bhavissati. khādissatha.
pli-tv-kd1:49.4.6: no ce bhavissati yāgu vā bhattaṃ vā khādanīyaṃ vā piṇḍāya caritvā bhuñjissathā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.4.7: evampi kho te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi vuccamānā rodantiyeva “yāguṃ detha, bhattaṃ detha, khādanīyaṃ dethā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.5.1: assosi kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya dāraka saddaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:49.5.4: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:49.5.5: “saccaṃ kira bhikkhave” bhikkhū jānaṃ ūnavīsativassaṃ puggalaṃ upasampādentī?”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.5.8: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā jānaṃ ūnavīsativassaṃ puggalaṃ upasampādessanti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.6.1: ūnavīsativasso, bhikkhave, puggalo akkhamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya, ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassānaṃ, duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ. uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tippānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ anadhivāsakajātiko hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:49.6.2: “vīsativasso va kho bhikkhave, puggalo khamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya, ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ. uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tippānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsakajātiko hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:50.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataraṃ kulaṃ ahivātaka rogena kālakataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:50.1.3: te bhikkhūsu pabbajitvā ekato piṇḍāya caranti.
pli-tv-kd1:50.1.4: atha kho so dārako pituno bhikkhāya dinnāya upadhāvitvā etadavoca.
pli-tv-kd1:50.1.10: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:50.1.11: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:51.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato ānandassa upaṭṭhākakulaṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ ahivātakarogena kālakataṃ hoti. dve ca dārakā sesā honti.
pli-tv-kd1:51.1.2: te porāṇakena āciṇṇakappena bhikkhū passitvā upadhāvanti.
pli-tv-kd1:51.1.9: kena nu kho upāyena ime dārakā na vinasseyyu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:51.1.10: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:51.1.11: “ussahanti pana te ānanda, dārakā kāke uḍḍāpetu?” nti.
pli-tv-kd1:51.1.13: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:52.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa dve sāmaṇerā honti
pli-tv-kd1:52.1.5: “kathaṃ hi nāma sāmaṇerā evarūpaṃ anācāraṃ ācarissantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:53.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tattheva rājagahe vassaṃ vasi. tattha hemantaṃ. tattha gimhaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.1.3: “āhundarikā samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ disā andhakārā. na imesaṃ disā pakkhāyantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:53.1.4: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.1.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.2.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānanda āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:53.2.5: “evambhante” ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā avāpuraṇaṃ ādāya anupariveṇiyaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:53.3.2: “bhagavatā āvuso ānanda, paññattaṃ ‘dasavassāni nissāya vatthuṃ. dasavassena nissayaṃ dātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.3.3: tattha ca no gantabbaṃ bhavissati. nissayo ca gahetabbo bhavissati, ittaro ca vāso bhavissati, puna ca paccāgantabbaṃ bhavissati. puna ca nissayo gahetabbo bhavissati.
pli-tv-kd1:53.3.4: sace amhākaṃ ācariyupajjhāyā gamissanti, mayampi gamissāma.
pli-tv-kd1:53.3.5: no ce amhākaṃ ācariyupajjhāyā gamissanti, mayampi na gamissāma.
pli-tv-kd1:53.4.1: atha kho bhagavā ogaṇena bhikkhusaṅghena dakkhiṇāgiriṃ cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:53.4.2.1: atha kho bhagavā dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā punadeva rājagahaṃ paccāgañchi.
pli-tv-kd1:53.4.3: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:53.4.4: “kinnu kho ānanda tathāgato ogaṇena bhikkhu saṅghena dakkhiṇāgiriṃ cārikaṃ pakkanto?”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:53.4.5: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:53.4.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:53.4.7: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena pañca vassāni nissāya vatthuṃ. abyattena yāvajīvaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.5.1: “pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.5.2: na asekhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, na asekhena samādhikkhandhena …pe… na asekhena paññākkhandhena na asekhena vimuttikkhandhena - na asekhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgato hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:53.5.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.5.4: “pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.5.5: asekhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekhena samādhikkhandhena -
pli-tv-kd1:53.5.9: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.6.1: aparehipi bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.6.2: assaddho hoti, ahiriko hoti, anottāpī hoti, kusīto hoti, muṭṭhassati hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:53.6.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.6.4: “pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.6.5: saddho hoti, hirimā hoti, ottāpī hoti, āraddhaviriyo hoti, upaṭṭhitasati hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:53.6.6: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.7.1: “aparehipi bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:53.7.2: adhisīle sīlavipanno hoti, ajjhācāre ācāravipanno hoti, atidiṭṭhiyā diṭṭhivipanno hoti, appassuto hoti, duppañño hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:53.7.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.7.4: “pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.7.5: na adhisīle sīlavipanno hoti, na ajjhācāre ācāravipanno hoti, na atidiṭṭhiyā diṭṭhivipanno hoti, bahussuto hoti, paññavā hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:53.7.6: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.8.1: “aparehipi bhikkhave, pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.8.2: āpattiṃ na jānāti, anāpattiṃ na jānāti, lahukaṃ āpattiṃ na jānāti, garukaṃ āpattiṃ na jānāti, ubhayāni kho panassa pātimokkhāni vitthārena na svāgatāni honti, na suvibhattāni na suppavattīni na suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso,
pli-tv-kd1:53.8.3: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.8.4: “pañcahi bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.8.5: āpattiṃ jānāti, anāpattiṃ jānāti, lahukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti, garukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti, ubhayāni kho panassa pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti, suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso,
pli-tv-kd1:53.8.6: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.9.1: “aparehipi bhikkhave, pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.9.2: āpattiṃ na jānāti, anāpattiṃ na jānāti, lahukaṃ āpattiṃ na jānāti, garukaṃ āpattiṃ na jānāti, ūnapañcavasso hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:53.9.3: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.9.4: “pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.9.5: āpattiṃ jānāti, anāpattiṃ jānāti, lahukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti, garukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti, pañcavasso vā hoti atireka pañcavasso vā,
pli-tv-kd1:53.9.6: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.10.1: “chahi bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.10.2: na asekhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, na asekhena samādhikkhandhena …pe… na asekhena paññākkhandhena …pe… na asekhena vimuttikkhandhena - na asekhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, ūnapañcavasso hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:53.10.3: imehi kho bhikkhave, chahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.10.4: “chahi bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.10.5: asekhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekhena samādhikkhandhena …pe… asekhena paññākkhandhena - asekhena vimuttikkhandhena - asekhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, pañcavasso vā hoti atirekapañcavasso vā,
pli-tv-kd1:53.10.6: imehi kho bhikkhave, chahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.11.1: “aparehipi bhikkhave, chahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.11.2: assaddho hoti, ahiriko hoti, anottāpī hoti, kusīto hoti, muṭṭhassati hoti, ūnapañcavasso hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:53.11.3: imehi kho bhikkhave, chahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.11.4: “chahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.11.5: saddho hoti, hirimā hoti, ottāpī hoti, āraddhaviriyo hoti, upaṭṭhitassati hoti, pañcavasso vā hoti, atirekapañcavasso vā,
pli-tv-kd1:53.11.6: imehi kho bhikkhave, chahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.12.1: “aparehipi bhikkhave, chahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.12.2: adhisīle sīlavipanno hoti, ajjhācāre ācāravipanno hoti, atidiṭṭhiyā diṭṭhivipanno hoti, appassuto hoti, duppañño hoti, ūnapañcavasso hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:53.12.3: imehi kho bhikkhave, chahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.12.4: “chahi bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.12.5: na adhisīle sīlavipanno hoti, na ajjhācāre ācāravipanno hoti, na atidiṭṭhiyā diṭṭhivipanno hoti, bahussuto hoti, paññavā hoti, pañcavasso vā hoti, atirekapañcavasso vā,
pli-tv-kd1:53.12.6: imehi kho bhikkhave, chahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.13.1: “aparehipi bhikkhave, chahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.13.2: āpattiṃ na jānāti, anāpattiṃ na jānāti, lahukaṃ āpattiṃ na jānāti, garukaṃ āpattiṃ na jānāti, ubhayāni kho panassa pātimokkhāni vitthārena na svāgatāni honti, na suvibhattāni na suppavattīni na suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso, ūnapañcavasso hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:53.13.3: imehi kho bhikkhave chahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:53.13.4: “chahi bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:53.13.5: āpattiṃ jānāti, anāpattiṃ jānāti, lahukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti, garukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti, ubhayāni kho panassa pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti, suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso, pañca vasso vā hoti atirekapañcavasso vā,
pli-tv-kd1:53.13.6: imehi kho bhikkhave, chahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbanti.”
pli-tv-kd1:54.1.1: atha kho bhagavā rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena kapilavatthu tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:54.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena kapilavatthu tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd1:54.1.3: tatrasudaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
pli-tv-kd1:54.1.4: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena suddhodanassa sakkassa nivesanaṃ, tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:54.1.5: atha kho rāhulamātā devī rāhulakumāraṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:54.2.1: atha kho rāhulo kumāro yena bhagavā, tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato purato, aṭṭhāsi:
pli-tv-kd1:54.2.4: atha kho rāhulo kumāro bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi:
pli-tv-kd1:54.2.7: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:54.3.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:54.3.4: paṭhamaṃ kesamassuṃ ohārāpetvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādāpetvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ kārāpetvā bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vandāpetvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdāpetvā añjalimpaggaṇhāpetvā ‘evaṃ vadehi’ti vattabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:54.3.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave, imehi tīhi saraṇagamanehi sāmaṇerapabbajja”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:54.4.1: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto rāhulaṃ kumāraṃ pabbājesi.
pli-tv-kd1:54.4.2: atha kho suddhodano sakko yena bhagavā, tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:54.4.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho suddhodano sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:54.5.1: “bhagavati me bhante, pabbajite anappakaṃ dukkhaṃ ahosi. tathā nande. adhimattaṃ rāhule.
pli-tv-kd1:54.5.2: puttapemaṃ bhante, chaviṃ chindati. chaviṃ chetvā cammaṃ chindati. cammaṃ chetvā maṃsaṃ chindati. maṃsaṃ chetvā nahāruṃ chindati. nahāruṃ chetvā aṭṭhiṃ chindati. aṭṭhiṃ chetvā aṭṭhimiñjaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati.
pli-tv-kd1:54.5.3: sādhu bhante, ayyā ananuññātaṃ mātāpitūhi puttaṃ na pabbājeyyu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:54.6.1: atha kho bhagavā suddhodanaṃ sakkaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi. samādapesi. samuttejesi. sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd1:54.6.2: atha kho suddhodano sakko bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:54.6.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd1:55.1.1: rāhulavatthukathā niṭṭhitā. atha kho bhagavā kapilavatthusmiṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena sāvatthi, tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:55.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena sāvatthi, tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd1:55.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd1:55.1.4: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato sāriputtassa upaṭṭhākakulaṃ āyasmato sāriputtassa santike dārakaṃ pāhesi:
pli-tv-kd1:55.1.12: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena ekena dve sāmaṇere upaṭṭhāpetuṃ. yāvatake vā pana ussahati ovadituṃ anusāsituṃ, tāvatake upaṭṭhāpetu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:56.1.2: “kati nu kho amhākaṃ sikkhāpadāni? kattha ca amhehi sikkhitabba?”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:56.1.4: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, sāmaṇerānaṃ dasa sikkhāpadāni. tesu ca sāmaṇerehi sikkhituṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:56.1.15: anujānāmi, bhikkhave, sāmaṇerānaṃ imāni dasa sikkhāpadāni. imesu ca sāmaṇerehi sikkhitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:57.1.1: tena kho pana samayena sāmaṇerā bhikkhūsu agāravā appatissā asabhāgavuttikā viharanti.
pli-tv-kd1:57.1.3: “kathaṃ hi nāma sāmaṇerā bhikkhūsu agāravā appatissā asabhāgavuttikā viharissantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:57.1.5: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatassa sāmaṇerassa daṇḍakammaṃ kātuṃ:
pli-tv-kd1:57.1.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave, imehi pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatassa sāmaṇerassa daṇḍakammaṃ kātu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:57.2.5: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū sāmaṇerānaṃ sabbaṃ saṅghārāmaṃ āvaraṇaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd1:57.2.6: sāmaṇerā ārāmaṃ pavisituṃ alabhamānā pakkamantipi. vibbhamantipi. titthiyesupi saṅkamanti.
pli-tv-kd1:57.2.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave yattha vā vasati, yattha vā paṭikkamati, tattha āvaraṇaṃ kātu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:57.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū sāmaṇerānaṃ mukhadvārikaṃ āhāraṃ āvaraṇaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd1:57.3.2: manussā yāgupānampi saṅghabhattampi karontā sāmaṇere evaṃ vadenti:
pli-tv-kd1:57.3.9: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhadantā sāmaṇerānaṃ mukhadvārikaṃ āhāraṃ āvaraṇaṃ karissantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:58.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū upajjhāye anāpucchā sāmaṇerānaṃ āvaraṇaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd1:58.1.3: kathaṃ nu kho amhākaṃ sāmaṇerā na dissantī?”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:58.1.7: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū amhe anāpucchā amhākaṃ sāmaṇerānaṃ āvaraṇaṃ karissantī?”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:59.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sāmaṇere apalāḷenti.
pli-tv-kd1:59.1.2: therā sāmaṃ dantakaṭṭhampi mukhodakampi gaṇhantā kilamanti.
pli-tv-kd1:60.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa kaṇṭako nāma sāmaṇero kaṇṭakiṃ nāma bhikkhuniṃ dūsesi.
pli-tv-kd1:60.1.3: “kathaṃ hi nāma sāmaṇero evarūpaṃ anācāraṃ ācarissatī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:60.1.16: anujānāmi bhikkhave, imehi dasahaṅgehi samannāgataṃ sāmaṇeraṃ nāsetu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro paṇḍako bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.2: so dahare bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.5: “nassa paṇḍaka. vinassa paṇḍaka. ko tayā attho?”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.6: so bhikkhūhi apasādito mahante mahante munigalle sāmaṇere upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.9: “nassa paṇḍaka. vinassa paṇḍaka. ko tayā attho?”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.10: so sāmaṇerehi apasādito hatthibhaṇḍe assabhaṇḍe upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.15: ye’pi imesaṃ na paṇḍakā, te’pi paṇḍake dūsenti.
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.17: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ hatthibhaṇḍānaṃ assabhaṇḍānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.18: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:61.1.19: “paṇḍako bhikkhave, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo. upasampanno nāsetabbo”ti. (1)
pli-tv-kd1:62.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro purāṇakulaputto khīṇakolañño sukhumālo hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:62.1.2: atha kho tassa purāṇakulaputtassa khīṇakolaññassa etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:62.1.3: “ahaṃ kho sukhumālo. na paṭibalo anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigantuṃ adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātikātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:62.1.4: kena nu kho ahaṃ upāyena sukhañca jīveyyaṃ? na ca kilameyyaṃ?”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:62.1.5: atha kho tassa purāṇakulaputtassa khīṇakolaññassa etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:62.1.6: “ime kho samaṇā sakyaputtiyā sukhasīlā sukhasamācārā subhojanāni bhuñjitvā nivātesu sayanesu sayanti.
pli-tv-kd1:62.1.7: yannūnāhaṃ sāmaṃ pattacīvaraṃ paṭiyādetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvaseyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:62.2.1: atha kho so purāṇakulaputto khīṇakolañño sāmaṃ pattacīvaraṃ paṭiyādetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhū abhivādeti.
pli-tv-kd1:62.3.1: atha kho so purāṇakulaputto khīṇakolañño āyasmatā upālinā anuyuñjiyamāno etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:62.3.4: “theyyasaṃvāsako bhikkhave, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo. upasampanno nāsetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:62.3.5: titthiyapakkantako bhikkhave, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo. upasampanno nāsetabbo”ti. (2.3)
pli-tv-kd1:63.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro nāgo nāgayoniyā aṭṭīyati. harāyati jigucchati.
pli-tv-kd1:63.1.3: “kena nu kho ahaṃ upāyena nāgayoniyā ca parimucceyyaṃ? khippañca manussattaṃ paṭilabheyyaṃ?”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:63.1.5: “ime kho samaṇā sakyaputtiyā dhammacārino samacārino brahmacārino saccavādino sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā.
pli-tv-kd1:63.1.6: sace kho ahaṃ samaṇesu sakyaputtiyesu pabbajeyyaṃ, evāhaṃ nāgayoniyā ca parimucceyyaṃ. khippañca manussattaṃ paṭilabheyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:63.2.1: atha kho so nāgo māṇavakavaṇṇena bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-kd1:63.2.3: tena kho pana samayena so nāgo aññatarena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ paccantime vihāre paṭivasati.
pli-tv-kd1:63.2.4: atha kho so bhikkhu rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya ajjhokāse caṅkamati.
pli-tv-kd1:63.2.5: atha kho so nāgo tassa bhikkhuno nikkhante vissattho niddaṃ okkami.
pli-tv-kd1:63.2.6: sabbo vihāro ahinā puṇṇo. vātapānehi bhogā nikkhantā honti.
pli-tv-kd1:63.3.1: atha kho so bhikkhu “vihāraṃ pavisissāmī”ti kavāṭaṃ panāmento addasa sabbaṃ vihāraṃ ahinā puṇṇaṃ. vātapānehi bhoge nikkhante. disvāna bhīto vissaramakāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:63.3.4: “ayaṃ āvuso, sabbo vihāro ahinā puṇṇo, vātapānehi bhogā nikkhantā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:63.3.5: atha kho so nāgo tena saddena paṭibujjhitvā sake āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd1:63.3.10: atha kho so nāgo bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:63.4.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā taṃ nāgaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd1:63.4.2: “tumhe ca khvattha nāgā. aviruḷhidhammā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye.
pli-tv-kd1:63.4.3: gaccha tvaṃ nāga, tattheva cātuddase paṇṇarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa uposathaṃ upavasa, evaṃ tvaṃ nāgayoniyā ca parimuccissasi. khippañca manussattaṃ paṭilabhissasī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:63.4.4: atha kho so nāgo “avirūḷhidhammo kirāhaṃ imasmiṃ dhammavinaye”ti dukkhī dummano assūni pavattayamāno vissaraṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd1:63.5.3: yadā ca sajātiyā methunaṃ dhammaṃ patisevati, yadā ca vissattho niddaṃ okkamati,
pli-tv-kd1:63.5.4: ime kho bhikkhave, dve paccayā nāgassa sabhāvapātukammāya.
pli-tv-kd1:63.5.5: tiracchānagato bhikkhave, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo”ti. (4)
pli-tv-kd1:64.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro māṇavako mātaraṃ jīvitā voropesi.
pli-tv-kd1:64.1.2: so tena pāpakena kammena aṭṭīyati, harāyati, jigucchati.
pli-tv-kd1:64.1.4: “kena nu kho ahaṃ upāyena imassa pāpakassa kammassa nikkhantiṃ kareyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:64.1.6: “ime kho samaṇā sakyaputtiyā dhammacārino samacārino brahmacārino saccavādino sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā.
pli-tv-kd1:64.1.7: sace kho ahaṃ samaṇesu sakyaputtiyesu pabbajeyyaṃ, evāhaṃ imassa pāpakassa kammassa nikkhantiṃ kareyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:64.2.1: atha kho so māṇavako bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-kd1:64.2.3: “pubbepi kho āvuso, upāli, nāgo māṇavakavaṇṇena bhikkhūsu pabbajito.
pli-tv-kd1:64.2.5: atha kho so māṇavako āyasmatā upālinā anuyuñjiyamāno etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:64.2.8: “mātughātako bhikkhave, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo. upasampanno nāsetabbo”ti. (5.)
pli-tv-kd1:65.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro māṇavako pitaraṃ jīvitā voropesi.
pli-tv-kd1:65.1.2: so tena pāpakena kammena aṭṭīyati, harāyati, jigucchati.
pli-tv-kd1:65.1.4: “kena nu kho ahaṃ upāyena imassa pāpakassa kammassa nikkhantiṃ kareyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:65.1.6: “ime kho samaṇā sakyaputtiyā dhammacārino samacārino brahmacārino saccavādino sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā. sace kho ahaṃ samaṇesu sakyaputtiyesu pabbajeyyaṃ, evāhaṃ imassa pāpakassa kammassa nikkhantiṃ kareyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:65.1.7: atha kho so māṇavako bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-kd1:65.1.9: pubbepi kho āvuso upāli nāgo māṇavakavaṇṇena bhikkhūsu pabbajito.
pli-tv-kd1:65.1.11: atha kho so māṇavako āyasmatā upālinā anuyuñjiyamāno etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:65.1.14: pitughātako bhikkhave, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo. upasampanno nāsetabbo”ti. (6)
pli-tv-kd1:66.1.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū sāketā sāvatthiṃ addhānamaggappaṭipannā honti.
pli-tv-kd1:66.1.2: antarāmagge corā nikkhamitvā ekacce bhikkhū acchindiṃsu, ekacce bhikkhū haniṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:66.1.3: sāvatthiyā rājabhaṭā nikkhamitvā ekacce core aggahesuṃ. ekacce corā palāyiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:66.1.4: ye te palāyiṃsu. te bhikkhūsu pabbajiṃsu. ye te gahitā, te vadhāya oniyyanti.
pli-tv-kd1:66.2.1: addasaṃsu kho te pabbajitā te core vadhāya onīyamāne. disvāna evamāhaṃsu:
pli-tv-kd1:66.2.2: “sādhu kho mayaṃ palāyimha. sacajja mayaṃ gaṇhīyeyyāma. mayampi evameva haññeyyāmā”ti .
pli-tv-kd1:66.2.5: atha kho te pabbajitā bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:66.2.8: arahantaghātako bhikkhave, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo. upasampanno nāsetabbo”ti. (7)
pli-tv-kd1:67.1.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhuniyo sāketā sāvatthiṃ addhānamaggappaṭipannā honti.
pli-tv-kd1:67.1.2: antarāmagge corā nikkhamitvā ekaccā bhikkhuniyo acchindiṃsu. ekaccā bhikkhuṇiyo dūsesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:67.1.3: sāvatthiyā rājabhaṭā nikkhamitvā ekacce core aggahesuṃ. ekacce corā palāyiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:67.1.4: ye te palāyiṃsu. te bhikkhūsu pabbajiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:67.1.5: ye te gahitā te vadhāya onīyanti.
pli-tv-kd1:67.1.6: addasāsuṃ kho te pabbajitā te core vadhāya onīyamāne. disvāna evamāhaṃsu:
pli-tv-kd1:67.1.7: “sādhu kho mayaṃ palāyimha. sacajja mayaṃ gaṇhīyeyyāma, mayampi evameva haññeyyāmā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:67.1.10: atha kho te pabbajitā bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:67.1.12: “bhikkhuṇīdūsako bhikkhave anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo. upasampanno nāsetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:67.1.13: saṅghabhedako bhikkhave, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo. upasampanno nāsetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:67.1.14: lohituppādako bhikkhave, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo. upasampanno nāsetabbo”ti. (8. 9. 10.)
pli-tv-kd1:68.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro ubhatobyañjanako bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:68.1.4: “ubhatobyañjanako bhikkhave, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo. upasampanno nāsetabbo”ti. (11.) anupasampannekādasavatthu niṭṭhitaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:69.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū anupajjhāyakaṃ upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:69.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū saṅghena upajjhāyena upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:69.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū gaṇena upajjhāyena upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:69.4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū paṇḍakūpajjhāyena upasampādenti. …pe…
pli-tv-kd1:70.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū apattakaṃ upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:70.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū acīvarakaṃ upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:70.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū apattacīvarakaṃ upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:70.4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū yācitakena pattena upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:70.5.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū yācitakena cīvarena upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:70.6.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū yācitakena pattacīvarena upasampādenti.
pli-tv-kd1:71.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū hatthacchinnaṃ pabbājenti. …pe…
pli-tv-kd1:72.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū alajjīnaṃ nissayaṃ denti.
pli-tv-kd1:72.1.5: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū alajjīnaṃ nissāya vasanti.
pli-tv-kd1:72.1.6: tepi na cirasseva alajjino honti pāpa
pli-tv-kd1:72.1.12: ‘na alajjīnaṃ nissayo dātabbo, na alajjīnaṃ nissāya vatthabba’nti.
pli-tv-kd1:72.1.13: kathannu kho mayaṃ jāneyyāma lajjiṃ vā alajjiṃ vā”ti?
pli-tv-kd1:72.1.15: “anujānāmi bhikkhave catūhapañcāhaṃ āgametuṃ yāva bhikkhusabhāgataṃ jānāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu kosalesu janapadesu addhānamaggappaṭipanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.1.5: ahañcamhi nissayakaraṇīyo addhānamaggappaṭipanno, kathannu kho mayā paṭipajjitabba”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.1.7: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, addhānamaggappaṭipannena bhikkhunā nissayaṃ alabhamānena anissitena vatthu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.2.1: tena kho pana samayena dve bhikkhū kosalesu janapade addhānamaggappaṭipannā honti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.2.4: atha kho tassa gilānassa bhikkhuno etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:73.2.7: ahañcamhi nissayakaraṇīyo gilāno. kathannu kho mayā paṭipajjitabba?”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.2.9: “anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā nissayaṃ alabhamānena anissitena vatthu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.3.1: atha kho tassa gilānupaṭṭhākassa bhikkhuno etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd1:73.3.4: ahañcamhi nissayakaraṇīyo. ayañca bhikkhu gilāno. kathannu kho mayā paṭipajjitabba”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.3.6: “anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānupaṭṭhākena bhikkhunā nissayaṃ alabhamānena yāciyamānena anissitena vatthu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.4.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu araññe viharati.
pli-tv-kd1:73.4.2: tassa ca tasmiṃ senāsane phāsu hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.4.6: ahañcamhi nissayakaraṇīyo araññe viharāmi. mayhañca imasmiṃ senāsane phāsu hoti, kathannu kho mayā paṭipajjitabba”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:73.4.8: “anujānāmi bhikkhave āraññikena bhikkhunā phāsuvihāraṃ sallakkhentena nissayaṃ alabhamānena anissitena vatthuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:73.4.9: yadā patirūpo nissayadāyako āgacchissati. tassa nissāya vasissāmi”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:74.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato mahākassapassa upasampadāpekho hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:74.1.2: atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmato ānandassa santike dūtaṃ pāhesi:
pli-tv-kd1:74.1.5: “nāhaṃ ussahāmi therassa nāmaṃ gahetuṃ. garu me thero”ti .
pli-tv-kd1:74.2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato mahākassapassa dve upasampadāpekhā honti.
pli-tv-kd1:74.3.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ upasampadāpekhā honti.
pli-tv-kd1:74.3.7: “anujānāmi bhikkhave dve tayo ekānusāvaṇe kātuṃ. tañca kho ekena upajjhāyena. na tveva nānupajjhāyenā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:75.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā kumārakassapo gabbhavīso upasampanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd1:75.1.6: upasampanno nu khomhi? na nu kho upasampanno?”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:75.1.8: “yaṃ bhikkhave mātukucchismiṃ paṭhamaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, paṭhamaṃ viññāṇaṃ pātubhūtaṃ, tadupādāya sāvassa jāti.
pli-tv-kd1:76.1.1: tena kho pana samayena upasampannā dissanti kuṭṭhikāpi gaṇḍikāpi kilāsikāpi sosikāpi apamārikāpi.
pli-tv-kd1:76.1.3: “anujānāmi bhikkhave upasampādentena terasa antarāyike dhamme pucchituṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ananusiṭṭhe upasampadāpekhe antarāyike dhamme pucchanti.
pli-tv-kd1:76.2.2: upasampadāpekhā vitthāyanti. maṅkū honti. na sakkonti vissajjetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.2.4: “anujānāmi bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ anusāsitvā pacchā antarāyike dhamme pucchitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:76.3.2: upasampadāpekhā tatheva vitthāyanti. maṅkū honti. na sakkonti vissajjetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.3.4: “anujānāmi bhikkhave ekamantaṃ anusāsitvā saṅghamajjhe antarāyike dhamme pucchituṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.3.8: ayaṃ te patto. ayaṃ saṅghāṭi. ayaṃ uttarāsaṅgo. ayaṃ antaravāsako.
pli-tv-kd1:76.4.2: duranusiṭṭhā upasampadāpekhā vitthāyanti maṅkū honti. na sakkonti, vissajjetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.4.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena anusāsitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:76.5.7: attanā vā attānaṃ sammannitabbaṃ. parena vā paro sammannitabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:76.5.12: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, ahaṃ itthannāmaṃ anusāseyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:76.6.5: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, itthannāmo itthannāmaṃ anusāseyyā”ti .
pli-tv-kd1:76.7.1: tena sammatena bhikkhunā upasampadāpekho upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd1:76.7.3: yaṃ jātaṃ taṃ saṅghamajjhe pucchante santaṃ atthiti vattabbaṃ, asantaṃ natthīti vattabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.7.4: mā kho vitthāsi. mā kho maṅku ahosi.
pli-tv-kd1:76.8.9: ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ kārāpetvā bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vandāpetvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdāpetvā añjaliṃ paggaṇhāpetvā upasampadaṃ yācāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd1:76.8.11: ullumpatu maṃ bhante, saṅgho anukampaṃ upādāya.
pli-tv-kd1:76.8.13: ullumpatu maṃ bhante, saṅgho anukampaṃ upādāya.
pli-tv-kd1:76.8.15: ullumpatu maṃ bhante, saṅgho anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:76.9.4: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, ahaṃ itthannāmaṃ antarāyike dhamme puccheyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd1:76.9.7: santaṃ atthiti vattabbaṃ. asantaṃ natthīti vattabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.10.3: ayaṃ itthannāmo itthannāmassa āyasmato upasampadāpekho. parisuddho antarāyikehi dhammehi. paripuṇṇassa pattacīvaraṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.10.4: itthannāmo saṅghaṃ upasampadaṃ yācati itthannāmena upajjhāyena.
pli-tv-kd1:76.10.5: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho itthannāmaṃ upasampādeyya itthannāmena upajjhāyena.
pli-tv-kd1:76.11.2: ayaṃ itthannāmo itthannāmassa āyasmato upasampadāpekho. parisuddho antarāyikehi dhammehi paripuṇṇassa pattacīvaraṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.11.3: itthannāmo saṅghaṃ upasampadaṃ yācati itthannāmena upajjhāyena.
pli-tv-kd1:76.11.5: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa upasampadā itthannāmena upajjhāyena, so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-kd1:76.12.3: ayaṃ itthannāmo itthannāmassa āyasmato upasampadāpekho, parisuddho antarāyikehi dhammehi. paripuṇṇassa pattacīvaraṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.12.4: itthannāmo saṅghaṃ upasampadaṃ yācati itthannāmena upajjhāyena.
pli-tv-kd1:76.12.6: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa upasampadā itthannāmena upajjhāyena, so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-kd1:76.12.10: ayaṃ itthannāmo itthannāmassa āyasmato upasampadāpekho, parisuddho antarāyikehi dhammehi, paripuṇṇassa pattacīvaraṃ.
pli-tv-kd1:76.12.11: itthannāmo saṅghaṃ upasampadaṃ yācati itthannāmena upajjhāyena.
pli-tv-kd1:76.12.13: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa upasampadā itthannāmena upajjhāyena, so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-kd1:76.12.16: khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd1:77.1.1: tāvadeva chāyā metabbā. utupamāṇaṃ ācikkhitabbaṃ. divasabhāgo ācikkhitabbo. saṅgīti ācikkhitabbā. cattāro nissayā ācikkhitabbā
pli-tv-kd1:77.1.5: saṅghabhattaṃ, uddesabhattaṃ, nimantanaṃ, salākabhattaṃ, pakkhikaṃ, uposathikaṃ, pāṭipadikaṃ. (1)
pli-tv-kd1:77.1.9: khomaṃ, kappāsikaṃ, koseyyaṃ, kambalaṃ, sāṇaṃ, bhaṅgaṃ. (2)
pli-tv-kd1:78.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ upasampādetvā ekakaṃ ohāya pakkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd1:78.1.2: so pacchā ekakova āgacchanto antarāmagge purāṇadutiyikāya samāgañchi.
pli-tv-kd1:78.1.8: so tassā methunaṃ dhammaṃ patisevitvā cirena agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd1:78.2.1: atha kho so bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd1:78.2.3: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, upasampādetvā dutiyaṃ dātuṃ, cattāri ca akaraṇīyāni ācikkhituṃ.”
pli-tv-kd1:78.2.4: upasampannena bhikkhunā methuno dhammo na patisevitabbo antamaso tiracchānagatāyapi.
pli-tv-kd1:78.2.5: yo bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ patisevati, assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo.
pli-tv-kd1:78.2.6: seyyathāpi nāma puriso sīsacchinno abhabbo tena sarīrabandhanena jīvituṃ,
pli-tv-kd1:78.2.7: evameva bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ patisevitvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo.
pli-tv-kd1:78.3.1: upasampannena bhikkhunā adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ na ādātabbaṃ antamaso tiṇasalākaṃ upādāya.
pli-tv-kd1:78.3.2: yo bhikkhu pādaṃ vā pādārahaṃ vā atirekapādaṃ vā adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyati, assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo.
pli-tv-kd1:78.3.3: seyyathāpi nāma paṇḍupalāso bandhanā pamutto abhabbo haritattāya,
pli-tv-kd1:78.3.4: evameva bhikkhu pādaṃ vā pādārahaṃ vā atirekapādaṃ vā adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyitvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo.
pli-tv-kd1:78.4.1: upasampannena bhikkhunā sañcicca pāṇo jīvitā na voropetabbo, antamaso kunthakipillikaṃ upādāya.
pli-tv-kd1:78.4.2: yo bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropeti antamaso gabbhapātanaṃ upādāya, assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo.
pli-tv-kd1:78.4.3: seyyathāpi nāma puthusilā dvedhā bhinnā appaṭisandhikā hoti,
pli-tv-kd1:78.4.4: evameva bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropetvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo.
pli-tv-kd1:78.5.1: upasampannena bhikkhunā uttarimanussadhammo na ullapitabbo antamaso suññāgāre abhiramāmīti.
pli-tv-kd1:78.5.2: yo bhikkhu pāpiccho icchāpakato asantaṃ abhūtaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ ullapati jhānaṃ vā vimokkhaṃ vā samādhiṃ vā samāpattiṃ vā maggaṃ vā phalaṃ vā, assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo.
pli-tv-kd1:78.5.3: seyyathāpi nāma tālo matthakacchinno abhabbo puna virūḷhiyā,
pli-tv-kd1:78.5.4: evameva bhikkhu pāpiccho icchāpakato asantaṃ abhūtaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ ullapitvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu āpattiyā adassane ukkhittako vibbhami.
pli-tv-kd1:79.1.2: so puna paccāgantvā bhikkhū upasampadaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-kd1:79.1.4: “idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhu āpattiyā adassane ukkhittako vibbhamati,
pli-tv-kd1:79.1.5: so puna paccāgantvā bhikkhū upasampadaṃ yācati,
pli-tv-kd1:79.1.9: sacāhaṃ na passissāmī ti, na pabbājetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.1.13: sacāhaṃ na passissāmī ti, na upasampādetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.2.4: sacāhaṃ na passissāmī ti, na osāretabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.2.8: no ce passati, labbhamānāya sāmaggiyā puna ukkhipitabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.3.1: “idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhu āpattiyā appaṭikamme ukkhittako vibbhamati,
pli-tv-kd1:79.3.2: so puna paccāgantvā bhikkhū upasampadaṃ yācati.
pli-tv-kd1:79.3.6: sacāhaṃ na paṭikarissāmī ti, na pabbājetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.3.10: sacāhaṃ na paṭikarissāmī ti, na upasampādetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.3.14: sacāhaṃ na paṭikarissāmī ti, na osāretabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.3.18: no ce paṭikaroti labbhamānāya sāmaggiyā puna ukkhipitabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.4.1: “idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhu pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhittako vibbhamati,
pli-tv-kd1:79.4.2: so puna paccāgantvā bhikkhū upasampadaṃ yācati,
pli-tv-kd1:79.4.10: sacāhaṃ na paṭinissajissāmī ti, na upasampādetabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.4.14: sacāhaṃ na paṭinissajissāmī ti na osāretabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.4.18: no ce paṭinissajati, labbhamānāya sāmaggiyā puna ukkhipitabbo.
pli-tv-kd1:79.4.80: yo so añño ca naggo ca
